Friend, I wanted to reach out one more time today, as my critical mid-month fundraising deadline approaches.
I'm thrilled that we have a slight lead in the polls – but let me be clear: **This didn't happen by accident. It's because this grassroots team is waking up every day and putting in the work to keep this seat and the Senate blue.**

body:
This month brought record-breaking heat to California. Again. We must act to end Big Oil’s influence in Washington and finally address the climate crisis.
# [](https://act.katieporter.com/go/9?t=1&akid=38981%2E3422442%2EMh5_rb)
It’s hot outside, Derek. Like, really hot:
[](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/ttp-em-20240712?refcode=em20240712-38981&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&refcode2=38981_3422442_Mh5_rb&akid=38981%2E3422442%2EMh5_rb)
Across California, dozens of communities have broken daily heat records since the start of July. Some areas experienced their hottest days on record. In Palm Springs, temperatures hit _**124**_ degrees last week.
**Climate change is here.** And if we don’t take action, it’s going to get exponentially worse. Big Oil executives have spent millions of dollars to buy D.C. politicians and block action on the climate crisis. As anyone who has been outside in California this month can tell you, they’ve been successful.
**Truth to Power is working to reverse Big Oil’s influence in Congress.** We’re electing leaders who refuse to take money from Big Oil, who fight to ban lobbyists from bribing our elected officials, and who will hold the fossil fuel industry accountable once in office.
**[Can you chip in today to support our work, and make sure we can elect leaders to Congress who will fight to rid Washington of Big Oil’s influence?](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/ttp-em-20240712?refcode=em20240712-38981&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&refcode2=38981_3422442_Mh5_rb&akid=38981%2E3422442%2EMh5_rb)**

Washington politicians have taken millions in contributions from Big Oil. **Many deny the existence of climate change altogether— _even as it unfolds before our very eyes._**
Climate change is dangerous for all of us. For the most vulnerable Americans, it’s especially deadly: Those who don’t have AC during a heat wave—or shelter during a hurricane—are most susceptible to the devastating harms of the climate crisis.
**For millions of Americans, ending Big Oil’s influence over our elected officials is no less than an existential issue.** The longer it takes us to get it done, the hotter our summers are going to get.
**[So we’re asking again: Will you chip in today to help Truth to Power elect climate champions who will hold Big Oil accountable in Congress?](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/ttp-em-20240712?refcode=em20240712-38981&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&refcode2=38981_3422442_Mh5_rb&akid=38981%2E3422442%2EMh5_rb)**

Team Truth to Power

Folks -- I just finished a major campaign rally in Detroit where I laid out my vision for a second term. But first, let me cut to the chase. This race is about you and your family. It's about your freedom. And it's about our democracy. We stand for the proposition that all people are created equal -- and I'll be _damned_ if I let Donald Trump walk this nation away from it. [**Peter, I need to know: Are you with me? The only way we will win is if we work together. So, is there any amount you can spare today to help defeat Trump in November? I'm going to ask for $25, but every dollar is appreciated. We have to be _for_ something. Unlike Donald Trump, I don't work for Big Oil, for Big Pharma, for the NRA. I work for you, the American people. **My first hundred days in a second term will continue to be all about the working people of this nation:**

* We're going to restore the protections of _Roe v. Wade_ as the law of the land.
* We're going to defend the right to vote.
* We're going to fight for Medicare and Social Security.
* We're going to make the tax code fair.
* We're going to raise the federal minimum wage.
* We're going to continue lowering the cost of prescription drugs and expanding health care.
* We're going to keep leading the world on climate and clean energy.
* We're going to make housing more affordable.
* We're going to get weapons of war off our streets and ban assault weapons.

**And above all else, we're going to uphold our Constitution and save our democracy.** So, I'll ask for the final time, Peter: [**If you believe in our vision for America, I'm kindly asking for your $25 to help us defeat Trump and continue our progress for the American people.**](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/u001.NV3IV8RXB3BPG-RgoenRivizIuY7_hyRTlr0Ev1A4jwo48Pzlh6he5y-OY0IheoZ4AGRvoA3kojih8fbzGC_njPS8OWC0MoTAB7_M3Jy0BbhIr-60LXn0DlcdN4kdeoN_McI2VLRjFGgD5QT7dwMwhir9gOk6P0BbRB-TrQNpSkc_IS1Z2TpvwG8ngxBXSDP-mhsAY8hx1GsJqT-vLhSHOeRNs54ksKw6tjLXD_SJ-FtSw2_HXi9Qs5v2J3yOQwkNz8WOZRRiRv7kz_3VunX5gImWjy1IEbXsb9xujrOh8TOmHdrFM80jNrHeCZYdrNtjFjNK3EbsP9K7fJ1V9v_CuS0ZRy4CninCnSzkAYGAB4uy0bdE3hgWM6CJNNMOafeJpJKAC5am6oyfL6FjmuTZOpaYwIlb0z-yR70LL2B68E_VB9TLZRbglPkdX0Vgvh1dRjsKX7uHc9560IC3aA449dk52TdKUWVFffyUp4s5t9ULki-ISTT2n4pNuCbOQcIlzynCRIwVKT6Hnp4awnndmxqomhr3_PSfQjQ85gr5I_bFTCFxI5_slLgwmb7UvuOuYRtGaVMHbLjY7ym0Yi3BgZdje4YvrWLUzcQBqEL6wptKRrVTSOyMLhK_wTrQymi7IuGE63ybV_BZ5a_uxHAgp3Au8rZkFw8yrCVpRCdQi4mbZ3h1xwsT7tVyQrlu5ZT6hBM_klEzE7PU_9G63P7srmW5Z2FFCSuP_cIcAWiK0krK1a4h2fuMOLhU80-LFL49unO50Qegrktm0a-3hLK7wWbVIs6c0xBCWfC0fSBXcURDu7H3JerGn9fRdwIZ0PUEgrIugZCg-iYR-97M38MVFrJpyez26uTbK9ONwu9lShHi2RR5EiT0ycpqav7zzsVTmNH4g7SwbsR24oUWPptzS7pAFfDfn478XHighgx81kHYpqa63RJKf1arT2xS-55AmO9WbBFKlHmqTrCDHznCZyIQ2-1yM3yjzYyweF9Y6u1whj0tRnP1LJQqF7xUYBY69FZqtYUNv0P-9IwJ2vQWg/480/1VJTZJ92THqb2XVu9YEoUg/h1/h001.6FnWtle1-PFq3LwsHQsdMnM9-q8UhsTW2FE37RXG_H0)

We're going to continue lowering the cost of prescription drugs and expanding health care. We're going to keep leading the world on climate and clean energy. We're going to make housing more affordable. We're going to get weapons of war off our streets and ban assault weapons. And above all else, we're going to uphold our Constitution and save our democracy. body:
We used to be taught to love our nation, cherish our history, and respect our fellow Americans. |
---
| _Please see a special message from our sponsor. If you would like to unsubscribe, visit this[link](http://links.newsletter.conservativedirect.com/e/encryptedUnsubscribe?_r=5b1853ae48754bee8f471363fe4933a9&_s=3c636580748c461f81861d309607bfed&_t=qf88po-f6rEKPhROgNbyrRu_7cinXg8imeCVzyEDhBwigdsduUcWFN02EDabRI_TzAHuf_O5YL5Vxmyjd8uLHDuHZcAerAGFUjj8aXum80USvUWgO64JVtscc3HHxK9h)_

| | [](http://links.newsletter.conservativedirect.com/u/click?_t=5b1853ae48754bee8f471363fe4933a9&_m=3c636580748c461f81861d309607bfed&_e=pTt4f3FTT-DMobBIUXDP9Ei-_pHTmvzZI_7jPwCrIPrENtbVd_mllZktMgyaLK6Fr-C_1EIvgRtfqwkKL_fHiYWtSdN71pTZ5LzJsoOIOn8J6o_TPlfC8Ww-IBEMYjqc83kRu_PBSnS-wHnkJqDNmS7k0AVJzIoYeWpHtJu9rBqGlM_6heHITC5JTqRTDTcPgk0eVBXtzFlBX0d9ktuqFb3_mZ-A-cvoaNWpR7w42MRIxgeAMHlcTTWns0x2UUMnqhMqfvIkJhcqopE5PIioKEPUhUjIgvEOZUv8hDAAkEtVh2DT6gbkQdmAx1_PMWBd4yEboIMTspGM3sx84bLDaudtIg8-1ORBUrg5ATY9uc2my9ZYVYDVvD5qapXDGMVwmFDdVR7y2jIpMXQU-P7ewg%3D%3D)

| Fellow Patriot,

You've probably noticed that children today aren't getting the same kind of education that you and I received when we were growing up.

We used to be taught to love our nation, cherish our history, and respect our fellow Americans. But all of that has changed.

In today's classroom, children are taught that America is fundamentally racist, that our history is one of oppression, and that we should focus on our differences instead of what unites us.

[](http://links.newsletter.conservativedirect.com/u/click?_t=5b1853ae48754bee8f471363fe4933a9&_m=3c636580748c461f81861d309607bfed&_e=pTt4f3FTT-DMobBIUXDP9Ei-_pHTmvzZI_7jPwCrIPrENtbVd_mllZktMgyaLK6Fr-C_1EIvgRtfqwkKL_fHiYWtSdN71pTZ5LzJsoOIOn8J6o_TPlfC8Ww-IBEMYjqc83kRu_PBSnS-wHnkJqDNmS7k0AVJzIoYeWpHtJu9rBqGlM_6heHITC5JTqRTDTcPgk0eVBXtzFlBX0d9ktuqFb3_mZ-A-cvoaNWpR7w42MRIxgeAMHlcTTWns0x2UUMnJRBt2Veso8vBoEA_ht3SiK4dl34xqGJY4R7aT1sKdbMMLJ_K5P6lKV3gL2KgV3EeCCW5SMinxWHXSW2tt680s032UfPVcOIR9uuL8VUro-BFF480K6wQk80wgDROy5ZSgST0rhTP9gq5RoKTt_Yg8g%3D%3D)
__To make matters worse: the right of parents to choose how and where their kids receive their education remains out of reach for most American families.

And this is exactly why we created our Little Patriots program--to give parents, grandparents, teachers, and caregivers a free online resource they can use to teach children unbiased civics lessons, history, and American values, anywhere and anytime--[completely free of charge.](http://links.newsletter.conservativedirect.com/u/click?_t=5b1853ae48754bee8f471363fe4933a9&_m=3c636580748c461f81861d309607bfed&_e=pTt4f3FTT-DMobBIUXDP9Ei-_pHTmvzZI_7jPwCrIPrENtbVd_mllZktMgyaLK6Fr-C_1EIvgRtfqwkKL_fHiYWtSdN71pTZ5LzJsoOIOn8J6o_TPlfC8Ww-IBEMYjqc83kRu_PBSnS-wHnkJqDNmS7k0AVJzIoYeWpHtJu9rBqGlM_6heHITC5JTqRTDTcPgk0eVBXtzFlBX0d9ktuqFb3_mZ-A-cvoaNWpR7w42MRZroxClXqN5FTHbsGWY3FEEdccnlo8JwrW0_sgiKROTaTcKJv3qCOxf1Mq71aPVIFkNAS4TSr62EV6D3_IMc0fa6VtuyUQb1I4alngoZxssz_7EvqJgYHEraHy-X5UIjllAl8IgylznDW9ivwWLOG8KA9CjLDpQyaYCiZPuV2TDQ%3D%3D)

**And now we plan to do even more.**

To meet the growing demand for educational resources that teach children to love their country and its history, we're taking Little Patriots on the road to bring these educational resources to schools, churches, and community organizations!

But to help us fund this coast-to-coast effort, I need your help today.

We depend on the generous support of patriots like you to help us fund this program and share it with children and families across our great nation.

# **Big Wins for Education**
Last night, lawmakers came to an agreement on Pennsylvania's next budget and passed historic investments for Pre-K to 12 education, higher education, public safety, and better jobs and business. One of the most notable changes to PA's next budget is an increase of over **$1 billion dollars** for basic education. That's money that will be used to address gaps for low-income school districts, student support services, crumbling and toxic school buildings, and specialized learning programs. [Senator Hughes explained](http://enews.senatorhughes.com/mail/util.cfm?mailaction=clickthru&gpiv=2100168260.172976.609&gen=1&mailing_linkid=11311): In addition to an over $1 billion increase for basic education, Pennsylvania will invest over $140 million for grants, scholarships, and other programs that will make higher education more affordable in Pennsylvania. Senator Hughes started the fight for more affordable higher education in 2017 when he introduced [**PA Promise**](http://enews.senatorhughes.com/mail/util.cfm?mailaction=clickthru&gpiv=2100168260.172976.609&gen=1&mailing_linkid=11312)**,** a plan to lower higher ed costs and help students avoid costly student loans. The new investments and reform that was adopted has many similar elements to PA Promise. We're proud to finally see bipartisan agreement on action that will make higher education more affordable and accessible. We know education unlocks opportunity. When we invest in our education system at all levels, we're opening doors for everyone in this Commonwealth. This year's budget makes great progress for the people of Pennsylvania and PA Senate Democrats will continue to make education funding a top priority and assess the needs of students, teachers, and administrators as we build future budgets.
* * *
**Every School in Pennsylvania Needs to Be a Great School** [****](http://enews.senatorhughes.com/mail/util.cfm?mailaction=clickthru&gpiv=2100168260.172976.609&gen=1&mailing_linkid=11313) [WATCH: Senator Hughes shares about the new educational opportunities Pennsylvania's new budget will deliver for Pennsylvanians.](http://enews.senatorhughes.com/mail/util.cfm?mailaction=clickthru&gpiv=2100168260.172976.609&gen=1&mailing_linkid=11314)
* * *
**[Visit our website](http://enews.senatorhughes.com/mail/util.cfm?mailaction=clickthru&gpiv=2100168260.172976.609&gen=1&mailing_linkid=11310) to learn more about what was included in this year's budget and how it will impact Pennsylvanians.**

subject: C.S. Lewis's Profound Insights
body:
C.S. Lewis was a war hero, a bright light during some very dark hours in world history.

This sponsored message from Trump Train News is on behalf of Hillsdale College [](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zjdkhi574ehv0eto7gld3fmas96dqqjdbqfcjqp0_rp22sh2s8i6eoj0c3hmco32chh2bs) Dear Fellow American, I hope you are having a fine day so far. Thanks for opening my email. Today, I’m writing to let you know about a special offer for you from Hillsdale College, a private, fiercely independent, conservative college located in south-central Michigan where I work. You may have heard of us on talk radio, social media, YouTube, podcasts, or even on _Fox News_ because of our educational outreach efforts on behalf of liberty—like our free online courses. __ And though we’re best known for educating Americans about the Constitution and founding principles through these free courses, one of our most popular courses has been about a famous _British_ author—C.S. Lewis. In fact, our free online course, **“[ An Introduction to C.S. Lewis: Writings and Significance,](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2z4apkcd8c8lilbdqj3257fh0unh7j2uvii5ncpvg_rp22sh2s8i6eoj0c3hmco32chh2bs)” **has more than 500,000 people enrolled. C.S. Lewis was a war hero, a bright light during some very dark hours in world history. He is one of my absolute favorite authors because... ...While you may know him for his landmark _Chronicles of Narnia_ series, he was also a brilliant philosopher, writer, and Christian apologist. That’s why we decided to develop this online course. Since launching **“[An Introduction to C.S. Lewis: Writings and Significance](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zpao16igbebij1tjt3uq1ptert8pq461v2ufhfq8_rp22sh2s8i6eoj0c3hmco32chh2bs),” **we’ve received an outpouring of thanks for offering a course that covers the breadth and scope of Lewis’ writings. [](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zoi0sbn385iipt5s6g8qb10utvm56iihd6u15gb0_rp22sh2s8i6eoj0c3hmco32chh2bs) We’ve also heard from many of our friends that they would love to own a DVD version. So, I’m pleased to announce that the C.S. Lewis course is available on DVD for your home library. You can also give it as a gift or use it in a small group, such as a Bible study or book club. We only made a few of these special sets, so get this premium edition of **“[An Introduction to C.S. Lewis: Writings and Significance](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zvi2ctlng0oa01h465oat5k5avbt54c0ros67090_rp22sh2s8i6eoj0c3hmco32chh2bs)”** on DVD today. Given how popular this course is, the DVD box set won’t last long. Reserve your DVD set now using this secure link, while they last: [**https://secure.hillsdale.edu/be-the-first-to-get-hillsdales-new-c-s-lewis-dvd-set/**](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zmoduactjq4lmnp8phia0nm75c9fvdout993k9g8_rp22sh2s8i6eoj0c3hmco32chh2bs) Warm regards, Bill Gray, ‘01 Vice President Institutional Advancement Hillsdale College

body:
We’ve been told our whole lives to eat certain fruits, vegetables, and whole grains to stay in good health.

We've been told our whole lives to eat certain fruits, vegetables, and whole grains to stay in good health.
However, according to Dr. Steven Gundry — a world-renowned heart surgeon — many so called **" health foods" in the American diet contain a dangerous toxin, that could be expanding your waistline.**
**" This toxin causes micro-tears to form in your fragile intestinal-wall — allowing bacteria and waste products to seep into your body."** Says Dr. Gundry.
This harmful condition is best known as "leaky gut," and it's affecting millions of people nationwide. **Warning signs include weight gain, fatigue, digestive discomfort, stiff, achy joints, and even skin problems.**
Dr. Gundry explains, "**These side effects are often mistaken for normal signs of aging, because leaky gut usually develops over a matter of years, and sometimes even decades. But I can assure you, the damage caused by these so called "health foods" is far from normal."**
The good news is, this problem can be **easily fixed from your own home.**
"It's very simple, you just have to know which foods are actually healthy, and which contain this hidden toxin," he goes on to explain.
By simply eliminating this harmful toxin, Dr. Gundry has seen thousands of his own patients make swift recoveries. (In fact, he even lost 70lbs himself!)
Now, after years of research, Dr. Gundry has decided to release an informative video to the public — free and uninterrupted — showcasing exactly which foods you need to avoid.
"Good health is one of life's toughest obstacles," he explains. "So, if this video can help people achieve that, I'll be thrilled to hear I was of help."
The video has since gone viral, first being shared by users on Facebook, then being featured on news sites like ABC and CBS.
So far, the comments and feedback have been outstanding, with thousands of Americans feeling better than they have in decades.

Dr. Gundry also serves as the personal physician to many A-list celebrities.
Most notable of which include legendary self-help guru Tony Robbins, Oscar award winning actor Alan Arkin, Grammy award winning singer Usher, and countless fortune 500 executives.
Now, there is one thing Dr. Gundry asks from his viewers: "If watching this helps you take control of your weight back, fight unwanted cravings, increase your energy, ease gas and bloating, or find relief from stiff, achy joints," Dr. Gundry says... "Then please share this video with your friends and loved ones. Together, we can help as many people avoid these health issues as possible."

body:
Not long ago, Elon Musk bought Twitter

| | | [](http://e.prolifeupdate.com/rd/9z2z7bmtp6a59c113t95cg2fu126kapm6itoe7dmfqo_rp22sh2s8i6eoj0c3hmepb6c9h2bs)

Friends, Not long ago, Elon Musk bought Twitter, changed his bio to Chief Twit, and sent me a DM that said: “Do you want the Babylon Bee restored? There will be no censorship of humor.”
---
[](http://e.prolifeupdate.com/rd/9z2z3r5cokcf0r5h0noh9l5u9313t66gsknirueaaf8_rp22sh2s8i6eoj0c3hmepb6c9h2bs)
---
| | We've been trying to think of a joke worth $44 billion ever since. But as resourceful and committed to free speech as he is, Musk is still just one man, and X is just one platform. Censorship remains the law of the land on virtually every other social media site run by Big Tech. X is a welcome but rare exception. Just a couple of months ago, I was notified that the conservative David Horowitz Freedom Center was permanently suspended by Vimeo for posting a talk I'd given about censorship. Just think about the irony of that for a second. As if they wanted to make my point for me more emphatically than I ever could, **they censored my talk about censorship. ** **It’s clear to us that what the censors want is submission.** They want unquestioning conformity. They want us to give up and start fighting. Stop telling jokes. Stop telling the truth. They want to raise the cost of speaking freely so high that we'd rather just keep our mouths shut to avoid all the hassle and penalties. They’re asking us if we’re willing to silence ourselves just to make things easier.** ****Our answer to that is NO. The truth is worth it. Free speech is worth more than whatever they can take from us.**** ** Of course, that's easier said than done. Standing against the censorious Left takes resources. I can tell you right now, The Babylon Bee would not have been able to take the stand that we did against Twitter if it hadn't been for the support of our subscribers.** ** That's our safety net. That's what gives us the confidence to fight back against big tech without being afraid of them putting us out of business. They can hurt us. Sure, they can reduce our reach and smear us in the media, but they can't shut us down. We have our supporters to thank for that. **I hope you'll consider joining the fight by****[**becoming a paid subscriber to the Babylon Bee.**](http://e.prolifeupdate.com/rd/9z2zn34me79dbv4sp49gupri5ecvrai48iahc3u3ap0_rp22sh2s8i6eoj0c3hmepb6c9h2bs)** ** ** But don't just support us. Support defenders of freedom wherever you find them. Subscribe to X Premium to support Elon. Ditch Disney and subscribe to the Daily Wire. Back anyone bold enough to say what's true, even if it comes at a cost. Especially if it comes at a cost. They'll be that much more fearless and that much harder to stop if they have a whole army of freedom-loving subscribers at their backs.
---

On Thursday, Governor Glenn Youngkin announced that Virginia is ranked "America's Top State for Business" by CNBC. The annual ranking measures all 50 states on 128 different metrics in 10 key categories of competitiveness to determine which states are delivering most effectively on the things that mean the most to business. Virginia was ranked #1 overall.

"Businesses choose every day: Where am I going to invest? Where are we going to grow? They're choosing Virginia," Governor Youngkin said.

Virginia has regained the honor as America's Top State for Business because Governor Youngkin's commonsense conservative leadership has prioritized the health and wellbeing of all Virginians with record investments in education and behavioral health, tax relief for hardworking families, cutting red tape and regulation, funding business-ready site development, and building a robust and talented workforce.

"Economic development is a team sport. I want to thank all of our partners, and the businesses large and small, for believing in Virginia," Governor Youngkin said.

In celebration of Independence Day, the Governor and First Lady bestowed the third "Spirit of Virginia Award" to the Colonial Williamsburg Foundation at its annual July Fourth celebration. Colonial Williamsburg embodies history -- maintaining treasured buildings and landscapes, offering extensive educational programs and cultural events, and contributing to local tourism and the economy. Through research, scholarship, and community engagement, Colonial Williamsburg enriches understanding and appreciation of 18th-century American life, making it a significant cultural and historical asset for Virginia.

Last week, First Lady Suzanne S. Youngkin joined Governor Glenn Youngkin at a Tri-City Chili Peppers game in Colonial Heights. The First Lady cheered on the Coastal Plain League's hottest new team, mingled with fans, and thanked the local law enforcement present.
---
|

| As part of the Independence Day celebrations in Capitol Square, the First Lady and Governor welcomed guests for Fourth of July tours at the Executive Mansion, the country's oldest governor's residence.
---

---
| In line with celebrating America's hard-won Independence, the First Lady spotlighted the importance of giving back at an American Red Cross blood drive in Petersburg. While there, the First Lady donated blood and thanked Red Cross volunteers and blood donors for the life-saving impact their time and donations have on so many.

This week, Governor Youngkin announced that more manufacturing jobs are coming to Virginia! As manufacturing growth continues to accelerate, Virginia offers the strategic location to meet growing demand from international customers.

Governor Youngkin announced that Simmons Equipment Company, a specialty mining equipment manufacturer, will invest $8.5 million to expand manufacturing operations into Russell County to meet increasing international demand for its soft rock machinery and create 75 new jobs.

name: Hillsdale College via Your America News
subject: Access "C.S.Lewis on Christianity"
body:
C.S. Lewis was a war hero, a bright light during some very dark hours in world history.

This sponsored message from Your America News is on behalf of Hillsdale College [](https://e.youramerica.news/rd/9z2zla4ibbr61r5etof9av5arjib0qovpc0h12smr3o_rp22sh2s8i6eoj0c3jm4o34s3h2bs) Dear Fellow American, I hope you are having a fine day so far. Thanks for opening my email. Today, I’m writing to let you know about a special offer for you from Hillsdale College, a private, fiercely independent, conservative college located in south-central Michigan where I work. You may have heard of us on talk radio, social media, YouTube, podcasts, or even on _Fox News_ because of our educational outreach efforts on behalf of liberty—like our free online courses. __ And though we’re best known for educating Americans about the Constitution and founding principles through these free courses, one of our most popular courses has been about a famous _British_ author—C.S. Lewis. In fact, our free online course, **“[ An Introduction to C.S. Lewis: Writings and Significance,](https://e.youramerica.news/rd/9z2znork9s2vsgd66vokvr59iukvbge3f9o9i6m5s78_rp22sh2s8i6eoj0c3jm4o34s3h2bs)” **has more than 500,000 people enrolled. C.S. Lewis was a war hero, a bright light during some very dark hours in world history. He is one of my absolute favorite authors because... ...While you may know him for his landmark _Chronicles of Narnia_ series, he was also a brilliant philosopher, writer, and Christian apologist. That’s why we decided to develop this online course. Since launching **“[An Introduction to C.S. Lewis: Writings and Significance](https://e.youramerica.news/rd/9z2zeuqd6ahj3i7ki4dhmcg2o6gbf5h358548su4q6g_rp22sh2s8i6eoj0c3jm4o34s3h2bs),” **we’ve received an outpouring of thanks for offering a course that covers the breadth and scope of Lewis’ writings. [](https://e.youramerica.news/rd/9z2z3hmcqalufu2v97fb3kcbhq4djb9fdkr7fpita3o_rp22sh2s8i6eoj0c3jm4o34s3h2bs) We’ve also heard from many of our friends that they would love to own a DVD version. So, I’m pleased to announce that the C.S. Lewis course is available on DVD for your home library. You can also give it as a gift or use it in a small group, such as a Bible study or book club. We only made a few of these special sets, so get this premium edition of **“[An Introduction to C.S. Lewis: Writings and Significance](https://e.youramerica.news/rd/9z2zct81cjioa5s823gnr1qf3s7moptltlv3f6na30g_rp22sh2s8i6eoj0c3jm4o34s3h2bs)”** on DVD today. Given how popular this course is, the DVD box set won’t last long. Reserve your DVD set now using this secure link, while they last: [**https://secure.hillsdale.edu/be-the-first-to-get-hillsdales-new-c-s-lewis-dvd-set/**](https://e.youramerica.news/rd/9z2zb6vkd0foouddgspm78arkmu5mfsnphsvkd3n5g8_rp22sh2s8i6eoj0c3jm4o34s3h2bs) Warm regards, Bill Gray, ‘01 Vice President Institutional Advancement Hillsdale College

Friends, Not long ago, Elon Musk bought Twitter, changed his bio to Chief Twit, and sent me a DM that said: “Do you want the Babylon Bee restored? There will be no censorship of humor.”
---
[](https://email.alert.freedomandlibertyreport.com/c/eJyMkLFu8yAURp8Gb44uFwzxwPBLkac_Hbp0tC7mOkEC28Kkbd6-cpUH6Ho-6ejo-7iOV4opLrc3yuzmVMayj8SjJ_9M69J65vZ7REDdgm2lGlUTHMg-aN2wkxbhbIxS0Nwd-6AnjWingEz9ZL3ynUUJvQ0SpG-iOzxgpYKzNro7GWNn1UNHGuRsCIUGSlzqaS7MYc20hBQ9l_osvK2lnqY1N8nda912of4JHAQOr1LPfMwChy3Rsgs1PGoeM4f4yEJdOFNMAs0B9_VRJhbqQvwiE-WN4m0R6jL8f-9kJ2VTXNi-YkpxN1ZouB2C34D6t5s-Hf4EAAD__12Abr0)
---
| | We've been trying to think of a joke worth $44 billion ever since. But as resourceful and committed to free speech as he is, Musk is still just one man, and X is just one platform. Censorship remains the law of the land on virtually every other social media site run by Big Tech. X is a welcome but rare exception. Just a couple of months ago, I was notified that the conservative David Horowitz Freedom Center was permanently suspended by Vimeo for posting a talk I'd given about censorship. Just think about the irony of that for a second. As if they wanted to make my point for me more emphatically than I ever could, **they censored my talk about censorship. ** **It’s clear to us that what the censors want is submission.** They want unquestioning conformity. They want us to give up and start fighting. Stop telling jokes. Stop telling the truth. They want to raise the cost of speaking freely so high that we'd rather just keep our mouths shut to avoid all the hassle and penalties. They’re asking us if we’re willing to silence ourselves just to make things easier.** ****Our answer to that is NO. The truth is worth it. Free speech is worth more than whatever they can take from us.**** ** Of course, that's easier said than done. Standing against the censorious Left takes resources. I can tell you right now, The Babylon Bee would not have been able to take the stand that we did against Twitter if it hadn't been for the support of our subscribers.** ** That's our safety net. That's what gives us the confidence to fight back against big tech without being afraid of them putting us out of business. They can hurt us. Sure, they can reduce our reach and smear us in the media, but they can't shut us down. We have our supporters to thank for that. **I hope you'll consider joining the fight by****[**becoming a paid subscriber to the Babylon Bee.**](https://email.alert.freedomandlibertyreport.com/c/eJyMkLFu8yAURp8Gb44uFwzxwPBLkac_Hbp0tC7mOkEC28Kkbd6-cpUH6Ho-6ejo-7iOV4opLrc3yuzmVMayj8SjJ_9M69J65vZ7REDdgm2lGlUTHMg-aN2wkxbhbIxS0Nwd-6AnjWingEz9ZL3ynUUJvQ0SpG-iOzxgpYKzNro7GWNn1UNHGuRsCIUGSlzqaS7MYc20hBQ9l_osvK2lnqY1N8nda912of4JHAQOr1LPfMwChy3Rsgs1PGoeM4f4yEJdOFNMAs0B9_VRJhbqQvwiE-WN4m0R6jL8f-9kJ2VTXNi-YkpxN1ZouB2C34D6t5s-Hf4EAAD__12Abr0)** ** ** But don't just support us. Support defenders of freedom wherever you find them. Subscribe to X Premium to support Elon. Ditch Disney and subscribe to the Daily Wire. Back anyone bold enough to say what's true, even if it comes at a cost. Especially if it comes at a cost. They'll be that much more fearless and that much harder to stop if they have a whole army of freedom-loving subscribers at their backs.
---
[**YES, I'LL STAND WITH THE BEE**](https://email.alert.freedomandlibertyreport.com/c/eJyMkLFu8yAURp8Gb44uFwzxwPBLkac_Hbp0tC7mOkEC28Kkbd6-cpUH6Ho-6ejo-7iOV4opLrc3yuzmVMayj8SjJ_9M69J65vZ7REDdgm2lGlUTHMg-aN2wkxbhbIxS0Nwd-6AnjWingEz9ZL3ynUUJvQ0SpG-iOzxgpYKzNro7GWNn1UNHGuRsCIUGSlzqaS7MYc20hBQ9l_osvK2lnqY1N8nda912of4JHAQOr1LPfMwChy3Rsgs1PGoeM4f4yEJdOFNMAs0B9_VRJhbqQvwiE-WN4m0R6jL8f-9kJ2VTXNi-YkpxN1ZouB2C34D6t5s-Hf4EAAD__12Abr0)

They’re asking us if we’re willing to silence ourselves just to make things easier. Our answer to that is NO. The truth is worth it. Free speech is worth more than whatever they can take from us. Of course, that's easier said than done. Standing against the censorious Left takes resources. I can tell you right now, The Babylon Bee would not have been able to take the stand that we did against Twitter if it hadn't been for the support of our subscribers. That's our safety net. That's what gives us the confidence to fight back against big tech without being afraid of them putting us out of business. They can hurt us. Sure, they can reduce our reach and smear us in the media, but they can't shut us down. We have our supporters to thank for that. I hope you'll consider joining the fight by But don't just support us. Support defenders of freedom wherever you find them. Subscribe to X Premium to support Elon. Dear Fellow Believer,

There are so many challenges that missionaries face today:

Language. Culture. Customs. Finances. Housing. Visas. Homesickness.

But at the top of every missionary's list when asked how to help is the need for prayer.

"Please pray for us!" is the plea of missionaries all over the world.

That's because they recognize it is only through God's power that they can overcome the obstacles they face and break through darkness with the light of the gospel.

Praying for missionaries is one of the best things we can do--not just for their sakes, but for ours. When we pray for missionaries, our thoughts are focused on the spiritual needs of people groups all over the world, and our hearts are aligned with God's desire to give them abundant life.

clean_body: There are so many challenges that missionaries face today: | | | Dear Fellow Believer, There are so many challenges that missionaries face today: Language. Culture. Customs. Finances. Housing. Visas. Homesickness. But at the top of every missionary's list when asked how to help is the need for prayer. "Please pray for us!" is the plea of missionaries all over the world. That's because they recognize it is only through God's power that they can overcome the obstacles they face and break through darkness with the light of the gospel. Praying for missionaries is one of the best things we can do--not just for their sakes, but for ours. When we pray for missionaries, our thoughts are focused on the spiritual needs of people groups all over the world, and our hearts are aligned with God's desire to give them abundant life. I'm hoping that by doing so, it will ignite a desire to make it an ongoing habit. If you can spare a few moments each day for one week to lift up the needs of men and women who are bringing the gospel to unreached areas, we would be so grateful! For the next seven days, we'll send you an email telling you about specific missionaries to pray for and the ministry they are doing. Will you help in this way? If so, go here to start receiving prayer requests in your inbox for the next seven days: On behalf of the missionaries that you will be praying for this week, thank you! Your prayers are more valuable than you might realize! God bless you, Emily Hall Prayer Content Specialist IMB Prayer Office | | International Mission Board | 3806 Monument Ave. Richmond, VA 23230 | (804) 353-0515 Defend the Constitution PO Box 1188 Fort Collins, CO 80522 | _

## Nearly All AT&T Customers Hacked
AT&T announced on Friday that a data breach in April gave [hackers access to records](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskLFuKyEQRb-G7VjBsDbrguI12_m1KVcDDF4ibCwYmeTvI6dOd6VbnKPzcd2vmEt-3P7jnRynumPg_KLdSm0kLPsyRZeIgMxETltQq101nKbD-cUbOsOSLuGiQSuKydoVPZ5OyWtjp-xAwaKsNlqBATNb1GElFQgg2jNZsSiKmWubP2t-8EGpfNcXtTnU-1TcwfzswvwTsAnYxhhz8P1Bo79_Adt7CtiQJcuIjNI3wnDIRqG22GXAUrpk-uIuB3aZJaZEgSkK2Kbm4nPkUnI_v0Vud8zlF8x_Z3g5-AkAAP__ZmNghg) of calls and texts of "nearly all" its cellular customers between May 1, 2022, and October 31, 2022. The data theft [during the six-month period](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxsz7Fu7CAQheGngQ4LBi7sLSjS0G3alNYsjNeT4GVlEzt5-8ipUx_pfPrfruMVufLj_ooLxT61EXPnncagjFXgRidLnIiArKRoAuhLuBj4J-doyDv8Ty5bX4zXoK0JE9oMxdhM3kqOoMHpYKzRYMEOAU2-kM4EUIKnIJymwr2tw3vjR59pqt9tp3XIbZE1zr0_N2FfBCQB6TiOAb-4becqIJ3fApIOApIBAQl7V7eVMM9qxvyhlnbjSip_br0ttG5yjeV5cK28-ZO-L8j1l-p_h-8RfgIAAP__8EJZDw) affected AT&T cellular and landline customers, as well as some users dating back to early January 2023. Hackers gained access to the data through AT&T's third-party cloud service. The Justice Department allowed AT&T [two national security exemptions](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxs0LFuwyAUheGnwRsWXLAhA0Olylu6VFVHC8N1TItDBLeJ8vaVO3c9Z_n0f57ns085XS9vfkdHa5l9oHTH2XCpOOhZd9GtiICqQycNCGushKHbnI_rav0yDMsSddRC-agVSDMEu46n8dQlBwK0MFJJAQpUb7wMFkVAgGhGNEwLjIlK7b9KutKGa36WO9Y-lL3LbiO6NaZeGEwMJr-EKz5afynHzWD6eD9WIr758I2VNyoZefTk-SNVzNgaDz-Nyo61MZgalfpkakqRqVcppTVaSttVF2-PlHNq4wG67D7lPwD9n-Pu4DcAAP__Rdthzg) and allowed the company not to report the cyber breach publicly until Friday. At least one person connected to the hack has been apprehended.
## Biden Opposition Grows
At least 20 congressional Democrats have now publicly called for President Biden to step down as doubts over Biden's health and ability to beat former President Trump this November continue to grow. [See the full list of congressional Democrats here](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskL1u7CAQhZ8Gd1gwsOBbUNzG3aZNaWEY1hNhszJkSd4-cuo0pzk6P_re78vdU6bj8eZ3dC2VxYdGL1wsl4qDXvQQXUIEVAM6aUFMdpJwGzZnzJTgFtHjpENc06rBhn9odFp1XG92IAcCtLBSSQEK1Gi9DBOKgADRGrRMC4zUyjl-FDrahil_lxeeYyj7kN3W2rMy9Z_BzGDuvY_-i0q9XAbz1c1gFvYSw2DOVBvfymdFHnEv4fSt8pUiHrxT2-LpO79CPPj96elxDKeLz045UzXXl8fuKf9ut79JvBz8BAAA__8azl_0). Democratic donors also have concerns. A report by the New York Times on Friday revealed that a political action committee has threatened to [withhold $90 million](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxsz71uwyAUQOGngQ2Le_nzwtDFW7p2tAjcxFTYWJjayttX6dz5DJ_O122-hVzy9vwMK_n-qHOIPZ80OwFKoJ41T_5BhKQ4eXAoRzcCGr74e7QB5AhgFOlgDYE2hFJKijYR3nn2KFFLBwokKlSDCxBHkpEQk7PkmJaUcq9t-K556ws9yque1IZYV1780vt-MPXBcGI4Xdc1vMJS67synDa6DoZTqltth9hbFfecaBPHz05N7CEKcNIYq0EPS18Lbz7tVy4lH_YtP9eQy5_U__8-Pf4GAAD__z5fWaw) in donations if Biden remained atop the ticket. subject: C.S. Lewis’s Profound Insight
body:
One of our most popular courses has been about a famous British author -- C.S. Lewis.

This sponsored message from Defend the Constitution is on behalf of Hillsdale College
[](https://links.defend-the-constitution.org/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=44d96b08b31245b494f641afc18f0875&_e=E2YJTWW3dnPyQvnF2tk-LvtJnHxet54ocJjgaejj9_gvYBq6A7poMUzq3VnGt0cbcjkaEDPa2LZPy5xdqu_w27RzQnKY_kyRd3GT11X3znqbuY1Nggu9lhMJYzP5A9P3VFxJIoZi3fFsmL9MgKUQEhPFpw1bd6fnBO1X4mK5xRj2EoNPeVqd1-gwjxjLXWBiHxCBTOpInn5PoKCP_VNvoZEVxWBVWb5LR2uCtMYMqM3CFzEJEtJNJc1nE1mY7S-0m4UTXxWJ8hcb2ROzs8XhtWhyxLSV5p4E7FGcduQ1EsSF36bVjIt3e2nFBjLuW4lkwfg4yCwmzHz5pQRWq9T2ygfwTaCCSK1oLLMluG0b1T8zS2lyOOi4HDIdIdmdv13KB6gOoPe-eygKK0G2Rib15pF1OwB1VwAPFFz550KrayUbs_iFl_YhkF0UatvTxoTq) Dear Fellow American, I hope you are having a fine day so far. Thanks for opening my email. Today, I'm writing to let you know about a special offer for you from Hillsdale College, a private, fiercely independent, conservative college located in south-central Michigan where I work. You may have heard of us on talk radio, social media, YouTube, podcasts, or even on _Fox News _because of our educational outreach efforts on behalf of liberty--like our free online courses. _ _ And though we're best known for educating Americans about the Constitution and founding principles through these free courses, one of our most popular courses has been about a famous _British_ author--C.S. Lewis. In fact, our free online course, **"[ An Introduction to C.S. Lewis: Writings and Significance,](https://links.defend-the-constitution.org/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=44d96b08b31245b494f641afc18f0875&_e=E2YJTWW3dnPyQvnF2tk-LvtJnHxet54ocJjgaejj9_gvYBq6A7poMUzq3VnGt0cbcjkaEDPa2LZPy5xdqu_w27RzQnKY_kyRd3GT11X3znqbuY1Nggu9lhMJYzP5A9P3VFxJIoZi3fFsmL9MgKUQEhPFpw1bd6fnBO1X4mK5xRj2EoNPeVqd1-gwjxjLXWBiHxCBTOpInn5PoKCP_VNvoZEVxWBVWb5LR2uCtMYMqM3CFzEJEtJNJc1nE1mY7S-0m4UTXxWJ8hcb2ROzs8XhtWhyxLSV5p4E7FGcduQ1EsQJDS0o4vea3QpqUW-EXDSDC53O9P6I5R1_9UOMb1NQLE1r9mkXENMvQZ0CU6YXl1_XtDCM6tZCk7H2G_ocwzoPolXxQYdeAwjFEk9x3beY1w4AzMusRuYZbdtWwWmupVOHdV5xnQWqX7HiEHRMwNhY)" **has more than 500,000 people enrolled. C.S. Lewis was a war hero, a bright light during some very dark hours in world history. # [Paul Revere never actually shouted, “The British are coming!”](https://track.historyfacts.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=sgk6l2&__onlt=h&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com)
### [U.S. History](https://track.historyfacts.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=sgk6l2&__onlt=h&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com)
[](https://track.historyfacts.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=sgk6l2&__onlt=h&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com)
| I n the popular imagination of many Americans, few aspects of the Revolutionary War are more iconic than the event that came to be known as “Paul Revere’s midnight ride.” On the evening of April 18, 1775, the Patriot leader rode from Boston to Lexington, Massachusetts, warning the rebelling colonists that British soldiers stationed in Boston were planning to march into the countryside surrounding Lexington and Concord. However, while Revere’s midnight ride was, in fact, a significant moment in the American Revolution, some details that found their way into the popular retelling have been subject to a bit of dramatic embellishment. Namely, Revere [never actually shouted](https://track.historyfacts.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=sgk6l2&__onlt=h&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com) the now-legendary warning, “The British are coming!” In fact, if he had shouted this, it would have been detrimental to his mission.
---
For one, at the time, colonists still considered themselves to be British subjects, and although they were rebelling against the British crown, American revolutionaries did not consider “the British'' to be a separate, hostile nation. What’s more, as a known revolutionary agent riding through a region full of British troops, Revere needed to complete his ride with as much discretion as possible. His actual journey was one of secrecy and narrow escapes, including a clandestine boat ride across the Charles River, during which he narrowly avoided capture from a British patrol ship before continuing his covert ride by horseback on the other side of the river. Revere did deliver crucial warnings about the British military’s impending advance on Lexington, but these warnings were quietly given to revolutionaries at individual households along his route.

## Paul Revere was not the only rider sent out to spread the warning about British soldiers.
While Paul Revere has gone down in history as an American hero, he wasn’t the only person who went on a secret ride in the middle of the night to warn colonists about the British soldiers’ plan to advance. At the same time that Revere set out on his ride from Boston to Lexington, another man, [William Dawes](https://track.historyfacts.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=sgk6l2&__onlt=h&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com), also departed Boston with instructions to alert colonial militias of the mobilizing British troops. Revere and Dawes had the same destination, but the routes they took were different: Revere left Boston by secretly crossing the Charles River, while Dawes took the riskier land route out of the city, which required him to sneak through a British checkpoint. As Dawes rode toward Lexington, he alerted other riders of the British movement, and these riders in turn spread the message to yet more colonial militia members throughout the countryside surrounding Lexington.

clean_body: In the popular imagination of many Americans, few aspects of the Revolutionary War are more iconic than the event that came to be known as “Paul Revere’s midnight ride.” | I n the popular imagination of many Americans, few aspects of the Revolutionary War are more iconic than the event that came to be known as “Paul Revere’s midnight ride.” On the evening of April 18, 1775, the Patriot leader rode from Boston to Lexington, Massachusetts, warning the rebelling colonists that British soldiers stationed in Boston were planning to march into the countryside surrounding Lexington and Concord. However, while Revere’s midnight ride was, in fact, a significant moment in the American Revolution, some details that found their way into the popular retelling have been subject to a bit of dramatic embellishment. Namely, Revere the now-legendary warning, “The British are coming!” In fact, if he had shouted this, it would have been detrimental to his mission. For one, at the time, colonists still considered themselves to be British subjects, and although they were rebelling against the British crown, American revolutionaries did not consider “the British'' to be a separate, hostile nation. What’s more, as a known revolutionary agent riding through a region full of British troops, Revere needed to complete his ride with as much discretion as possible. His actual journey was one of secrecy and narrow escapes, including a clandestine boat ride across the Charles River, during which he narrowly avoided capture from a British patrol ship before continuing his covert ride by horseback on the other side of the river. Revere did deliver crucial warnings about the British military’s impending advance on Lexington, but these warnings were quietly given to revolutionaries at individual households along his route. | Thank you for supporting our advertisers! | By the Numbers | | Approximate distance (in miles) of Paul Revere’s ride 12.5 | | Children fathered by Paul Revere 16 | Children fathered by Paul Revere 16 | | Colonial militiamen who confronted 700 British troops in Lexington the day after Revere’s ride 77 | | Known participants in the Boston Tea Party, including Paul Revere 116 | Known participants in the Boston Tea Party, including Paul Revere 116 | | | Did you know? ---|---|--- Paul Revere was not the only rider sent out to spread the warning about British soldiers. While Paul Revere has gone down in history as an American hero, he wasn’t the only person who went on a secret ride in the middle of the night to warn colonists about the British soldiers’ plan to advance. At the same time that Revere set out on his ride from Boston to Lexington, another man, , also departed Boston with instructions to alert colonial militias of the mobilizing British troops. Revere and Dawes had the same destination, but the routes they took were different: Revere left Boston by secretly crossing the Charles River, while Dawes took the riskier land route out of the city, which required him to sneak through a British checkpoint. As Dawes rode toward Lexington, he alerted other riders of the British movement, and these riders in turn spread the message to yet more colonial militia members throughout the countryside surrounding Lexington. | Make no mistake: Mitch McConnell's time as Senate GOP leader was one of the worst things to ever happen to the Senate. It will take years for our country and our democracy to fully recover from his decades of corruption, cronyism, extremism, and obstruction. But Rick Scott as Senate GOP leader would be much, much worse. He oversaw one of the biggest Medicare frauds in U.S. history and used the money to buy his seat. Then he wrote the plan to raise taxes on working families and end Medicare and Social Security. THEN, he co-sponsored a nationwide ban on abortions that could send doctors to prison. All that destruction and he's only been in the Senate for a single term. Imagine what he could do as GOP Leader. In short — Rick Scott shouldn't be allowed to step foot in the U.S. Senate, let alone lead the GOP caucus, whether they have the majority or not. But with McConnell out of the way, Scott is under the impression that this will be an easy win. I need your help to prove him wrong. [This is a make-or-break moment not just for my campaign but for our entire country. body:
One of our most popular courses has been about a famous British author -- C.S. Lewis.

This sponsored message from Full Mag News is on behalf of Hillsdale College
[](https://links.fullmagnews.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=e10541052e3044bea4f615e712c5e277&_e=uOmhrSCokWMlp_jRBuCfVuzzE838Sq8UyyxHJaI4C3KM55OdBJCYtJN5k2GQ48uwg6BGw5VgYb0IH-GiiqCAO1tXxUulIkYv39ED3tWZn4EMQcCsrnbD8HOvre9IrpwAscgQwqHU7u7B15HM64CNy0hxwiCZk6OOxPoGuoIng7uQompVlm4ziWwFgXdiAcJrWjMxOyNEeq20gZeO4ZyJODFxL_8c0XhejiaiX_i5rGizfpsA-nd2pUSrIczliHC-2gktyLDt-Wb2XV695dWKM5R8ATm-8dLWpk05z2KEyOSV7zWxaINTIxLztecb0lBBddKjZ0E78xptGwDswQHMOLcQOTGu3rBplHgmdlrtl4S27C4GPpgjoUnwtsPKp5VSJwHvpH4n6fwSy39ppeg3ioil6CVppQdaWilec1R9xFve5kqI5_zjaR17cYk-Rho6) Dear Fellow American, I hope you are having a fine day so far. Thanks for opening my email. Today, I'm writing to let you know about a special offer for you from Hillsdale College, a private, fiercely independent, conservative college located in south-central Michigan where I work. You may have heard of us on talk radio, social media, YouTube, podcasts, or even on _Fox News _because of our educational outreach efforts on behalf of liberty--like our free online courses. _ _ And though we're best known for educating Americans about the Constitution and founding principles through these free courses, one of our most popular courses has been about a famous _British_ author--C.S. Lewis. In fact, our free online course, **"[ An Introduction to C.S. Lewis: Writings and Significance,](https://links.fullmagnews.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=e10541052e3044bea4f615e712c5e277&_e=uOmhrSCokWMlp_jRBuCfVuzzE838Sq8UyyxHJaI4C3KM55OdBJCYtJN5k2GQ48uwg6BGw5VgYb0IH-GiiqCAO1tXxUulIkYv39ED3tWZn4EMQcCsrnbD8HOvre9IrpwAscgQwqHU7u7B15HM64CNy0hxwiCZk6OOxPoGuoIng7uQompVlm4ziWwFgXdiAcJrWjMxOyNEeq20gZeO4ZyJODFxL_8c0XhejiaiX_i5rGizfpsA-nd2pUSrIczliHC-2gktyLDt-Wb2XV695dWKM5R8ATm-8dLWpk05z2KEyOQKmMxunZFp5mww11C8ZVxAgenS448WqAfOd0j0kS5hIonMpDQBYL_ZNam2ZzlYazNtrmyTpbAWUQoyoiep13FIikbkVQFq_lG2P3boVjozuK8Z9u5sPYJx1rVsNYOj1YS3vZOSfOV5EfmNxFH4tsP4)" **has more than 500,000 people enrolled. C.S. Lewis was a war hero, a bright light during some very dark hours in world history. He is one of my absolute favorite authors because... ...While you may know him for his landmark _Chronicles of Narnia_ series, he was also a brilliant philosopher, writer, and Christian apologist. That's why we decided to develop this online course. Since launching **"[An Introduction to C.S. Lewis: Writings and Significance](https://links.fullmagnews.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=e10541052e3044bea4f615e712c5e277&_e=uOmhrSCokWMlp_jRBuCfVuzzE838Sq8UyyxHJaI4C3KM55OdBJCYtJN5k2GQ48uwg6BGw5VgYb0IH-GiiqCAO1tXxUulIkYv39ED3tWZn4EMQcCsrnbD8HOvre9IrpwAscgQwqHU7u7B15HM64CNy0hxwiCZk6OOxPoGuoIng7uQompVlm4ziWwFgXdiAcJrWjMxOyNEeq20gZeO4ZyJODFxL_8c0XhejiaiX_i5rGizfpsA-nd2pUSrIczliHC-2gktyLDt-Wb2XV695dWKM5R8ATm-8dLWpk05z2KEyOQxNf-THtcm8j9LAdHXtE9SX0ZEyIb41Fb7taWzX2gQK-lEcHGJ_4EE4C-XjnuQT9mVq4UoJuFE3sRGdpiHIiFqAQv_bkmt_nPgxypCO8ztPGeebyDy_f_gj8e6DgwHPqfDxO5gkRyDM290HCfXARQa)," **we've received an outpouring of thanks for offering a course that covers the breadth and scope of Lewis' writings. [](https://links.fullmagnews.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=e10541052e3044bea4f615e712c5e277&_e=uOmhrSCokWMlp_jRBuCfVuzzE838Sq8UyyxHJaI4C3KM55OdBJCYtJN5k2GQ48uwg6BGw5VgYb0IH-GiiqCAO1tXxUulIkYv39ED3tWZn4EMQcCsrnbD8HOvre9IrpwAscgQwqHU7u7B15HM64CNy0hxwiCZk6OOxPoGuoIng7uQompVlm4ziWwFgXdiAcJrWjMxOyNEeq20gZeO4ZyJODFxL_8c0XhejiaiX_i5rGizfpsA-nd2pUSrIczliHC-2gktyLDt-Wb2XV695dWKM5R8ATm-8dLWpk05z2KEyOQM8xl-Pm4UmtEJqCm93o843GsFtOaK8rBtRI0ugOKxiLldKLLH-hgbY9VG9zC8eBUh8sc8JmemDWc8sMX_amwWjkqm1XYQpijCM7lW0n5YFKzaEYl6AaTLdoQAmC_qSn_xbKdObf2kC6D30YvVM0PH) We've also heard from many of our friends that they would love to own a DVD version. So, I'm pleased to announce that the C.S. Lewis course is available on DVD for your home library. You can also give it as a gift or use it in a small group, such as a Bible study or book club. We only made a few of these special sets, so get this premium edition of **"[An Introduction to C.S. Lewis: Writings and Significance](https://links.fullmagnews.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=e10541052e3044bea4f615e712c5e277&_e=uOmhrSCokWMlp_jRBuCfVuzzE838Sq8UyyxHJaI4C3KM55OdBJCYtJN5k2GQ48uwg6BGw5VgYb0IH-GiiqCAO1tXxUulIkYv39ED3tWZn4EMQcCsrnbD8HOvre9IrpwAscgQwqHU7u7B15HM64CNy0hxwiCZk6OOxPoGuoIng7uQompVlm4ziWwFgXdiAcJrWjMxOyNEeq20gZeO4ZyJODFxL_8c0XhejiaiX_i5rGizfpsA-nd2pUSrIczliHC-2gktyLDt-Wb2XV695dWKM5R8ATm-8dLWpk05z2KEyOSl-SkGUJXtgkCUVKYLL9EJhn6bnx_ME-u5E5RIQ1Pg9dGIsKCvo9Ob9pBwHFJR1C7arEmaG0hmN1f8pBmqfQKp4k_oSGl5FtnntYawcDrQCW7jin5D3Ou50dmJ2VIM3zIuu-gqB3XS8YXBYEXQo8cs)"** on DVD today. Friends, Not long ago, Elon Musk bought Twitter, changed his bio to Chief Twit, and sent me a DM that said: "Do you want the Babylon Bee restored? There will be no censorship of humor."
---
[](https://links.freedomnationtoday.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=e9a097d99fd947f6951e05df75af1f9b&_e=4K8gmEjtOuFh2NIWwNuAooyuNe5FWu17c5yZoGnfwWD4K7rFhcDxA8PCkh7Qef8840nwCeOF1op2vTJllFrcA34zRVtvwbuWJfEmjQrJ4FdmVvKQ1Mfabg6leKT5vVzalND1xFqs3VaibpatPqpCsCVln7oE5toxet08xOJjdpFIqQc402MkC_XJpPVCZf4kjAxOyyOOYfAgz_XHpcuvcLEvsqsYocq8q3Xb-QPcnqv98U-pXcYBcSMCP0YxIp-zu-WvC4R4Otn7TSNfPKk82g%3D%3D)

| | We've been trying to think of a joke worth $44 billion ever since. But as resourceful and committed to free speech as he is, Musk is still just one man, and X is just one platform. Censorship remains the law of the land on virtually every other social media site run by Big Tech. X is a welcome but rare exception. Just a couple of months ago, I was notified that the conservative David Horowitz Freedom Center was permanently suspended by Vimeo for posting a talk I'd given about censorship. Just think about the irony of that for a second. As if they wanted to make my point for me more emphatically than I ever could, **they censored my talk about censorship. ** **It 's clear to us that what the censors want is submission. **They want unquestioning conformity. They want us to give up and start fighting. Stop telling jokes. Stop telling the truth. They want to raise the cost of speaking freely so high that we'd rather just keep our mouths shut to avoid all the hassle and penalties. They're asking us if we're willing to silence ourselves just to make things easier. ** ** **Our answer to that is NO. The truth is worth it. Free speech is worth more than whatever they can take from us.** ** ** Of course, that's easier said than done. Standing against the censorious Left takes resources. I can tell you right now, The Babylon Bee would not have been able to take the stand that we did against Twitter if it hadn't been for the support of our subscribers. ** ** That's our safety net. That's what gives us the confidence to fight back against big tech without being afraid of them putting us out of business. They can hurt us. Sure, they can reduce our reach and smear us in the media, but they can't shut us down. We have our supporters to thank for that. **I hope you'll consider joining the fight by****[**becoming a paid subscriber to the Babylon Bee.**](https://links.freedomnationtoday.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=e9a097d99fd947f6951e05df75af1f9b&_e=4K8gmEjtOuFh2NIWwNuAooyuNe5FWu17c5yZoGnfwWD4K7rFhcDxA8PCkh7Qef8840nwCeOF1op2vTJllFrcA34zRVtvwbuWJfEmjQrJ4FdmVvKQ1Mfabg6leKT5vVzaumGrS3XGvIQXEq1q5Sypekk7AF0rDXEytqPJpQIPdanYS-GHm7M09l_gTlVJCDZ_nWnPu7bRpXU-q8F32qrhLYTcIKHypHwfKjMiZuWAvy-CBYR0Tpk-J9VRSCxyUbxxMCjc5d-PW7oWO-Kzlt23Mg%3D%3D)** ** ** But don't just support us. Support defenders of freedom wherever you find them. Subscribe to X Premium to support Elon. Ditch Disney and subscribe to the Daily Wire. Back anyone bold enough to say what's true, even if it comes at a cost. Especially if it comes at a cost. They'll be that much more fearless and that much harder to stop if they have a whole army of freedom-loving subscribers at their backs.

name: Douglas Carswell
subject: The Mississippi conservatives that oppose Trump on school choice
body:
| | | [View this email in your browser](https://mailchi.mp/mspolicy/educationstandards-11572819?e=5703353baa)
---
| |
---
| Dear Friend,

**Donald Trump wants it. Last week, the GOP adopted it as part of their 2024 platform.** Parents in Mississippi overwhelmingly support it.

**_So why do some Mississippi ‘conservatives’ oppose school choice?_**
---
| [ ](https://mspolicy.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=60d4052c66b6745831ccdf7c8&id=ef2d2b5384&e=5703353baa)
---
_Click here to listen_
| Mississippi Republicans have had control of the Governor’s mansion since 2004. They have held the Senate since 2011 and the House since 2012. Yet little progress has been made to give families control over their child’s share of education tax dollars.

**Mississippi has made less progress on school choice in 12 years than Arkansas, Louisiana and Alabama made in the past 12 months.** All three neighboring states now have universal school choice programs.

**_Louisiana passed school choice legislation a few weeks ago despite only having had a Republican governor for a year! _**

When many Mississippi politicians name-check school choice in speeches, they like to cite their support for Charter Schools. Great! **But less than 1 percent of schools in Mississippi are Charter Schools.**

**Although a law was passed a decade ago to allow Charter Schools, the administrative state in Jackson has done all it can to stifle the growth of Charter Schools.** The Charter Authorizer Board has rejected 80 percent of new school applications. Why has so little been done to change this?

The only significant progress made more recently was the 2024 school funding reform which gives every student a personalized education budget that reflects their needs (and which MCPP was heavily involved in). But what good is a personalized budget for students if they cannot spend it at a school of their choice?

**_Arkansas and other states achieved change because their leaders have been honest about the need for change._**

In contrast, the conservative movement in Mississippi has indulged the myth of the ‘Mississippi miracle’ – the fantasy that we are seeing spectacular gains in education outcomes. We simply aren’t. **If standards in our schools were so great, why are one in four students routinely absent? **

**_Now that the states around us are galloping full tilt towards school choice, the absence of leadership on this issue is starting to become obvious._**

Parents in Mississippi will notice when they see families in neighboring states using the $7,000 – 9,000 a year that the state will soon begin to pay into Education Freedom Accounts to send their kids to a school of their choice.

**_Team Trump might start to notice, too._**

Stopping school choice won’t just harm the career of Mississippi students. It could be a bad career move for those wanting to find favor in Washington. Opposing school choice could make for awkward future moments at Mar-A-Lago – assuming one is still invited.

Have an awesome weekend!
---
| [Forward this email to a friend!](https://mspolicy.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=60d4052c66b6745831ccdf7c8&id=b9f855aa65&e=5703353baa "Forward this email to a friend!")
---
| |
---
Warm regards,

Douglas Carswell
President & CEO

---

Friends, Not long ago, Elon Musk bought Twitter, changed his bio to Chief Twit, and sent me a DM that said: "Do you want the Babylon Bee restored? There will be no censorship of humor."
---
[](https://links.conservativesgive.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=0d169559cfa048bf9828fd7a64a75d21&_e=tmK2vzIp0yoMNvrWtcPWN4eeYi3xP_3H0xWyISNKoTeEIF0gUKNc_xUT5QIk-nmJXQ5c0l20wpUu29F7RRLBUWEMxugn1dpzcFlSuamlbr8W0J7gy_t4m_U949H3y-GzGjwojiaNZN6l3T25Sr8Ga8OCuPQcOOsS5iQgVu_Nj5tCpvce74fN5hy7LK9-tiJtTfCbXFR-v0y5IVuDUspJM44ZrlajxEDegRdkRabBtIvPAL7x1ub13ERauorcdNl2U9t9W1RRrJOfXJBkP3NHbw%3D%3D)

| | We've been trying to think of a joke worth $44 billion ever since. But as resourceful and committed to free speech as he is, Musk is still just one man, and X is just one platform. Censorship remains the law of the land on virtually every other social media site run by Big Tech. X is a welcome but rare exception. Just a couple of months ago, I was notified that the conservative David Horowitz Freedom Center was permanently suspended by Vimeo for posting a talk I'd given about censorship. Just think about the irony of that for a second. As if they wanted to make my point for me more emphatically than I ever could, **they censored my talk about censorship. ** **It 's clear to us that what the censors want is submission. **They want unquestioning conformity. They want us to give up and start fighting. Stop telling jokes. Stop telling the truth. They want to raise the cost of speaking freely so high that we'd rather just keep our mouths shut to avoid all the hassle and penalties. They're asking us if we're willing to silence ourselves just to make things easier. ** ** **Our answer to that is NO. The truth is worth it. Free speech is worth more than whatever they can take from us.** ** ** Of course, that's easier said than done. Standing against the censorious Left takes resources. I can tell you right now, The Babylon Bee would not have been able to take the stand that we did against Twitter if it hadn't been for the support of our subscribers. ** ** That's our safety net. That's what gives us the confidence to fight back against big tech without being afraid of them putting us out of business. They can hurt us. Sure, they can reduce our reach and smear us in the media, but they can't shut us down. We have our supporters to thank for that. **I hope you'll consider joining the fight by****[**becoming a paid subscriber to the Babylon Bee.**](https://links.conservativesgive.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=0d169559cfa048bf9828fd7a64a75d21&_e=tmK2vzIp0yoMNvrWtcPWN4eeYi3xP_3H0xWyISNKoTeEIF0gUKNc_xUT5QIk-nmJXQ5c0l20wpUu29F7RRLBUWEMxugn1dpzcFlSuamlbr8W0J7gy_t4m_U949H3y-GzPcqKk5PxWv6-ji3v1tVsqQC49bYl8btaX9T-XJm1rX5s0_Pj9sGwmCw86SnSF71ivR1Mbq_zNJLaYF3JSYHlogATWxBRokzE4Xa-X1nqx-Nq2VbsWZCdrUk39olKMdoigoww6XgvjOXvneBG5X3U5A%3D%3D)** ** ** But don't just support us. Support defenders of freedom wherever you find them. Subscribe to X Premium to support Elon. Ditch Disney and subscribe to the Daily Wire. Back anyone bold enough to say what's true, even if it comes at a cost. Especially if it comes at a cost. They'll be that much more fearless and that much harder to stop if they have a whole army of freedom-loving subscribers at their backs.

name: Mike Pompeo
subject: I have a few quick questions before next week’s convention
disclaimer_text: Paid for by the NRCC and not authorized by any candidate or candidate's committee
body:
This will only take a minute

|
---
| | |

name: International Mission Board
subject: Here’s how you can help a missionary today
body:
There are so many challenges that missionaries face today:

| | | [](https://links.freedomnationtoday.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=395333fc5b1a4e7e84486e5c740b47b9&_e=IoDGyHev7HOl34K1NO_VAZWqt4XmsYw-7jrzXnWaNcq10mOErqiM6vVxMQHnsMk5w44JvQ0_aQI9TlUNFtT5haE8Kgh_7xLUVUWzaaEW_sdejw02TkYfYotqqprXDYoisWtV6AZ8ijplpK3Iv-bjIst75t5jGJ6_86-HOUx-QKLvlTd72Y32VlrgpoIqt6zS3dbeGveim_3uXMyfy2Pqtb8zPZxTkeZ35HQUEYocyMu6aqn85XR09bO1yNduQn5DABaVrPIBmNINmC5oaSYTy92b2cDDsdkxXsZ54kV1wvRKs1VvnOQu9gmdt4feFz16MuNCNadNroIqZknw2MP6ZCtub18ogX6V2D5GmVIbr2D_V1C_SSEQdiAo8lzsVD9N)
---
Dear Fellow Believer,

There are so many challenges that missionaries face today:

Language. Culture. Customs. Finances. Housing. Visas. Homesickness.

But at the top of every missionary's list when asked how to help is the need for prayer.

"Please pray for us!" is the plea of missionaries all over the world.

That's because they recognize it is only through God's power that they can overcome the obstacles they face and break through darkness with the light of the gospel.

Praying for missionaries is one of the best things we can do--not just for their sakes, but for ours. When we pray for missionaries, our thoughts are focused on the spiritual needs of people groups all over the world, and our hearts are aligned with God's desire to give them abundant life.
---
[](https://links.freedomnationtoday.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=395333fc5b1a4e7e84486e5c740b47b9&_e=IoDGyHev7HOl34K1NO_VAZWqt4XmsYw-7jrzXnWaNcq10mOErqiM6vVxMQHnsMk5w44JvQ0_aQI9TlUNFtT5haE8Kgh_7xLUVUWzaaEW_sdejw02TkYfYotqqprXDYoisWtV6AZ8ijplpK3Iv-bjIst75t5jGJ6_86-HOUx-QKLvlTd72Y32VlrgpoIqt6zS3dbeGveim_3uXMyfy2PqtV5vVTTlcH8DsczHYlm4hAESeQ-J3d1s0l4fFxB-N3wR9bvBaRb_rF-qCJZlQxbLxMFZZkTQtf8njdiCPtW51okncd7QW1Nfo4wP-buRdDEBRL0E5P1CBxZeUnjYXkqpwF71HXJwkNHk96HpJXTKcYFJjVVWGcDNqZFUNQfNJs3p)
---
I'm hoping that by doing so, it will ignite a desire to make it an ongoing habit.

If you can spare a few moments each day for one week to lift up the needs of men and women who are bringing the gospel to unreached areas, we would be so grateful!

For the next seven days, we'll send you an email telling you about specific missionaries to pray for and the ministry they are doing. Will you help in this way?

**If so, go here to start receiving prayer requests in your inbox for the next seven days:** [https://welcome.imb.org/pray_for_missionary_lp.html](https://links.freedomnationtoday.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=395333fc5b1a4e7e84486e5c740b47b9&_e=IoDGyHev7HOl34K1NO_VAZWqt4XmsYw-7jrzXnWaNcq10mOErqiM6vVxMQHnsMk5w44JvQ0_aQI9TlUNFtT5haE8Kgh_7xLUVUWzaaEW_sdejw02TkYfYotqqprXDYoisWtV6AZ8ijplpK3Iv-bjIst75t5jGJ6_86-HOUx-QKLvlTd72Y32VlrgpoIqt6zS3dbeGveim_3uXMyfy2PqtdJuHhVSrwEsRm_v5OiQjeD54_hr-2xLj5aAeI5iA0wZ3itbgo6UXV8pEUqqtGJzovFMEMhhiHFMoOwtDs2TAPrkoE9Q5QgfgeVbm4HeLfTyBNTajqxvBlw8IL98ulV8PuiOSe3DUzLG3lqQtFEnrbJmrWBLhHju5JcXjCe0nfrI)

On behalf of the missionaries that you will be praying for this week, thank you! Your prayers are more valuable than you might realize!

God bless you,

Emily Hall

name: Dr. Robert Jeffress
subject: End-time resources you can’t miss!
body:
http://paracom.paramountcommunication.com/p/vsfK3BYWNA

Do you ever despair that Jesus will never return?

http://paracom.paramountcommunication.com/p/osfK3BYWNA

Hello
Friend,
Do you
ever despair that Jesus will never return?
When we
all get to Heaven, what a day of rejoicing that will be!
When we
all see Jesus, we'll sing and shout the victory!
The words
of this old hymn say it perfectly ... Christ's return is going to
be glorious!
But
between now and then, how should we live? What does God's Word
say about end times? As the world grows increasingly sinful ...
what should our response be?

When I
have those kinds of questions, I turn to the book of Revelation,
which I've found helps provide answers and strength in these dark
days.
And
today, I'm pleased to offer you my verse-by-verse study of the
book of Revelation entitled Final Conquest.
Final
Conquest is my first commentary on the book of Revelation. It's
all about the return of Jesus Christ, the most hope-filled event
in human history.
This book
will help you face the future with confidence! God doesn't want
you to live in fear. Final Conquest will unpack God's plan as
never before - you'll be encouraged!

With your
generous donation to Pathway to Victory-- to help keep our
ministry strong, for you and your family, and for listeners and
viewers across the country--I will send you a copy of Final
Conquest for free!
You can
make your most generous donation here:
https://secure.ptv.org/final-conquest-generous-gift-kit-1
One day
soon the darkness will pass...and our long-awaited King of kings
and Lord of lords will return and make His final conquest.
Until
that moment, we are focusing our hope on Christ and working
together to proclaim the gospel and expand His coming kingdom.

Sincerely,
Dr.
Robert Jeffress
Senior
Pastor, First Baptist Dallas

We’ve seen a surge of donations since we told you this big news:
| [](https://click.everyaction.com/k/88807792/485212033/-3547583?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAxMy8xLzg5Mjk0IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogImQxMmQ3MWY3LTE5NDEtZWYxMS04NmMzLTYwNDViZGQ5ZTA5NiIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=hYi97PyI8EfZsMqC8I8sGMu9SPB1xzLOOtQD0KZV-J4=&emci=1b74b752-6e40-ef11-86c3-6045bdd9e096&emdi=d12d71f7-1941-ef11-86c3-6045bdd9e096&ceid=8431045)

Peter, **When election analysts rate a race a “TOSS-UP,” it truly means it’s anyone’s game. ** The truth of the matter is _(thanks in large part to partisan gerrymandering!)_ that only a few contests ever make it on a “toss-up” list. So when we saw that a top analyst at _Sabato’s Crystal Ball_ rated SIX of the legislative chambers we’re targeting this year as toss-ups, we knew it was a big deal. **After those ratings were released, we saw a surge of donations to support this important work. But since we emailed you earlier this month about how critical these races are, we haven’t received a donation from you just yet.** [**We’re reaching out because there’s still a chance for you to join all the folks who are supporting this work right now. It will go a long way toward turning these “TOSS-UP” chambers into wins for fair maps. Can we count on you to chip in right away?**](https://click.everyaction.com/k/88807796/485212035/1763522771?refcode=don_ndrc_tier1_email_julyfun_email_20240713-NDRC-Tier1-RaceRatingsRedux_&utm_source=email&utm_medium=email&utm_term=don&utm_content=20240713-NDRC-Tier1-RaceRatingsRedux_&utm_campaign=julyfun&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAxMy8xLzg5Mjk0IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogImQxMmQ3MWY3LTE5NDEtZWYxMS04NmMzLTYwNDViZGQ5ZTA5NiIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=hYi97PyI8EfZsMqC8I8sGMu9SPB1xzLOOtQD0KZV-J4=) **The expert from _Sabato’s Crystal Ball_ listed the following state’s legislative chambers as “TOSS-UPs” – so here’s a quick analysis of what’s a stake in each:** **→ Arizona:** Republicans hold majorities in both chambers of the Arizona legislature, but if we flip just two seats in each, we can flip both the House and Senate and strengthen the state’s redistricting process. **→ Michigan:** While Democrats hold a trifecta in Michigan, Republicans are trying to take back the House this November. If they do, they could attempt to roll back progress on fair maps by targeting the state’s independent redistricting commission. **→ Minnesota:** Democrats won a trifecta of their state’s government in 2022, but this year, *only* the State House is on the ballot. Republicans only need to flip five seats to flip it back and block all the amazing progress we’ve seen from the Land of 10,000 Lakes this year. **→ New Hampshire:** It’s the Republicans who hold a trifecta in New Hampshire — and since mid-cycle Congressional redistricting is permitted in this state, the GOP could choose to rewrite their maps at any given moment. Democrats need to win the legislature to put that possibility of mid-cycle GOP gerrymandering to rest. **→ Pennsylvania:** Democrats hold the House and the governor’s seat, but Republicans control the Senate. If we can protect the House majority *and* flip the Senate, we will achieve another Democratic trifecta. **Your urgent donation to the NDRC will help us ramp up our efforts in these critical races — and more across the country — so we can lock in some major victories for democracy this November and beyond.

The truth of the matter is (thanks in large part to partisan gerrymandering!) that only a few contests ever make it on a “toss-up” list. So when we saw that a top analyst at Sabato’s Crystal Ball rated SIX of the legislative chambers we’re targeting this year as toss-ups, we knew it was a big deal. After those ratings were released, we saw a surge of donations to support this important work. But since we emailed you earlier this month about how critical these races are, we haven’t received a donation from you just yet. = The expert from Sabato’s Crystal Ball listed the following state’s legislative chambers as “TOSS-UPs” – so here’s a quick analysis of what’s a stake in each: → Arizona: Republicans hold majorities in both chambers of the Arizona legislature, but if we flip just two seats in each, we can flip both the House and Senate and strengthen the state’s redistricting process. → Michigan: While Democrats hold a trifecta in Michigan, Republicans are trying to take back the House this November. If they do, they could attempt to roll back progress on fair maps by targeting the state’s independent redistricting commission. → Minnesota: Democrats won a trifecta of their state’s government in 2022, but this year, only the State House is on the ballot. Republicans only need to flip five seats to flip it back and block all the amazing progress we’ve seen from the Land of 10,000 Lakes this year. → New Hampshire: It’s the Republicans who hold a trifecta in New Hampshire — and since mid-cycle Congressional redistricting is permitted in this state, the GOP could choose to rewrite their maps at any given moment. | | Friend, Even when Tennessee heat has it feeling like a dadgum steam room, I still love a good cookout with family and friends. But as we all came together around the grill on the 4th of July, it got me thinking about how much things cost these days. Bidenomics has been brutal on our wallets, and if you’re hosting a shindig anytime soon, you’re bound to feel the burn.

A trip to the grocery store is enough to drain your savings account—and it’s not right. If you’re fed up with the way things are going, you’re not alone. **[We need to take our country back and stop this runaway train. clean_body: Inflation is that unwanted guest at your summer BBQ. | | | | | | | | Friend, Even when Tennessee heat has it feeling like a dadgum steam room, I still love a good cookout with family and friends. But as we all came together around the grill on the 4th of July, it got me thinking about how much things cost these days. Bidenomics has been brutal on our wallets, and if you’re hosting a shindig anytime soon, you’re bound to feel the burn. Everything from beef to hamburger buns is up again this year—and I hope you’ve got a citrus tree in your yard. If not, even making your own fresh-squeezed lemonade will cost you than it did last summer. The Left will tell you that inflation is cooling, but on their receipts. A trip to the grocery store is enough to drain your savings account—and it’s not right. If you’re fed up with the way things are going, you’re not alone. Thanks for joining me in this fight to restore fiscal sanity and prosperity in America. Let’s make every dollar count again. name: Gabby Giffords

body:
When I dedicated my life’s work to making our communities safer from gun violence, my biggest fear was that we would come up short.
#

Hi friends,
It’s Gabby. We’re launching an urgent mid-month fundraising drive today, so I’m reaching out personally to ask you to contribute $3 to our work at GIFFORDS. But before I ask, I want to give you an explanation for why this is so important—especially right now.
When I dedicated my life’s work to making our communities safer from gun violence, my biggest fear was that we would come up short. I knew friends would help launch our effort, but I knew we needed significant grassroots support to prove that the American people were on our side.
I worried because the stakes are high. Lives are on the line. And it scared me because anything less than undeniable success would have been seen as a sign that there was no real support for change, and that would set us back even further.
But I took the leap of faith and put my trust in people like you. Now, look at where we are eleven years later. Hundreds of laws passed in nearly every state. The first federal gun safety legislation in over three decades is now law. Our work—together—has saved countless lives.
But the work is not done. Just like my road to recovery, there are still challenges ahead, and I need you by my side to overcome them.
The gun lobby has deep pockets, and they are targeting our gun safety champions at every level to undo our progress. So I’m putting my trust in this team again to do everything we can in these next 72 hours before our mid-month fundraising drive ends.

name: Candace Owens, BLEXIT
subject: BLEXIT backs the blue
body:
http://paracom.paramountcommunication.com/p/vWbFmZYW2N
We must stop the deception that is harming urban communities and
demeaning police around the nation.
http://paracom.paramountcommunication.com/p/oWbFmZYW2N

Friend,

I am so
grateful for our police officers.

As an
American who believes in law and order, truth, and justice, I
have always stood with the public servants who protect our
communities.

Please
join me in thanking uniformed men and women by signing our 'Back
the Blue Petition' and letting brave officers know that we are
grateful for their service and sacrifice.

Sign the
'Back the Blue Petition'

Unfortunately, a few years ago, radicals began propelling
criminals into heroes overnight and campaigning to "defund the
police."

I refuse
to accept that we must cater to the bottom denominator of our
society and that the black community must fight and scream and
demand support for the people in our community who are up to no
good.

That's
one of the reasons I founded BLEXIT - an organization focused on
shifting the culture in Black America as well as educating and
uplifting minorities through educational programs and acts of
community service.

Around
the nation, our BLEXIT chapters have supported local officers,
while so many others have turned their backs on those who serve
our communities.

To join
these chapters and stand with police officers, please sign the
national petition today.

Sign the
'Back the Blue Petition'

This
summer, BLEXIT Maryland spent the day giving back to the
Baltimore Police Department and learned some history about the
city's police force.

The first
state chapter - BLEXIT North Carolina - paid a visit to local
officers in July. Our State Director showered them with thank-you
notes and delicious food as a token of BLEXIT's appreciation.

If you
'Back the Blue' - and believe that we must support local heroes -
please sign the national petition right away.

While the
'defund the police' crowd wants us to think minorities stand with
them - polls show that the vast majority of black voters (more
than 80%) want police funding to stay the same or even increase.

We've
been sold a lot of lies by anti-police radicals - those lies have
been a detriment to Black American culture, the country as a
whole, and the police officers who fight for justice every day.

We must
stop the deception that is harming urban communities and
demeaning police around the nation.

If you
are an American, no matter what color you are, you should want
law and you should want order. That is the way forward.

Join me
in letting our police officers know that you support law and
order, justice, and their valiant efforts to keep our communities
safe.

Sign the
'Back the Blue Petition'

Candace
Owens
Chair of
BLEXIT
Powered
by Turning Point USA
