I've never felt right about 9 unelected people getting lifelong appointments to the highest court in the land. The people of Pennsylvania get to hold me accountable every 6 years at the ballot box. There's also a code of ethics senators have to follow. And our colleagues can investigate complaints of misconduct and even expel us. The Supreme Court — which has the power to uphold or strike down every single law Congress passes — has nothing like that. Even after Clarence Thomas got busted accepting lavish trips from conservative billionaire Harlan Crow, the Court didn't do much. They released a new code of ethics, but it's got a loophole bigger than the Liberty Bell: There's no enforcement mechanism. The only way to remove a justice is impeachment, resignation, or death. So I'm calling for an overhaul of the Supreme Court. For starters, they need a code of ethics with an actual enforcement mechanism. And I don't think justices whose partners actively support an insurrection should then get to rule on whether or not we hold those insurrectionists accountable. Just a thought... It's no surprise that over 50% of Americans disapprove of the court. Their behavior is pretty shitty: Clarence Thomas accepting a staggering $4.2 million in gifts His wife trying to overturn the results of the 2020 election Justice Alito just shrugging of his wife flying pro-January 6th and white Christian nationalist flag But so are their rulings: Overturning Roe v. Wade, abolishing national protections for abortion Throwing out Chevron — which says experts, not judges, should uphold the standards for thing like clean air, water, and food safety Granting Donald Trump immunity If these things pissed you off, you're not alone. The good news is we can do something about it. ❤️ John John Fetterman U.S. Senator from Pennsylvania | | Email us: info@johnfetterman.com

Just this week, Las Vegas saw temperatures exceed 115°F for five straight days, prompting public health warnings and leaving residents struggling to cope. The heat wave gripping the West Coast claimed lives, with Death Valley reaching a blistering 120°F. Temperatures throughout the Pacific Northwest are reaching record highs that pose an especially serious threat to communities where many houses and apartments lack air conditioning. And the situation in the Northeast isn’t any less alarming. The region’s heat index recently surpassed 100°F, straining infrastructure and causing travel delays for tens of thousands of people. It might be easy to assume I’m talking about Hawley’s continued opposition to marriage equality. He even voted against it in 2022. While Josh Hawley does seem to care a lot about what happens in my bedroom, I’m actually not married — just gay.
While it’s safe to assume Hawley’s opposition to civil rights protections for gay Americans means he doesn’t want me to be a parent anyway, his assault on my right to build and raise a family has a lot more to do with reproductive freedom — something that matters to each and every one of you reading this.
Like many Americans — women, men, gay, straight — I had to rely on IVF to build my family. I’m so incredibly thankful for the doctors, donors, and rockstar surrogates who helped bring my kids into the world. Those women gave me life. They gave me the chance to have a family. And I will be forever indebted to them.
My son Ben was born in 2019, and my daughter Lucy was born in 2022 — just a few months before the _Dobbs_ decision. As any parent with IVF kids can tell you, it isn’t easy. It’s expensive, takes time, and often fails. Fertilized embryos will almost inevitably be lost, and the costs associated with indefinite storage means extra embryos are almost always either donated to research, donated to family, or discarded. It’s an immense privilege to be able to build a family with IVF, when it should be a right.
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/88830677/485279838/2113074009?source=LOC_EM_FR_2024.07.13_KunceCohen_B1_F1_S1_C1_30OP_N-T1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTIvMS85Mjg3NiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIxZTEyZmFmNy0zOTQxLWVmMTEtODZjMy02MDQ1YmRkOWUwOTYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=7cwAWxbnyvSjWaq_Yeud_q4C4FulXV0sepJ7kacmf2Q=)

Friends,
If you think the Supreme Court is out of control now, imagine the consequences if Donald Trump appoints two, three, or four more justices.
It’s a real possibility and a grave threat to our democracy, civil rights, and environmental protections.
My opponent, Jim Jordan, has staunchly supported Trump’s judicial appointments.
He has consistently backed nominees more interested in pushing a radical, conservative agenda than upholding the principles of justice and fairness.
If Jordan is allowed to stay in office, his unwavering support for Trump’s judicial nominees threatens the balance of the Court even further, endangering the rights and liberties we hold dear.
Let’s show Jim Jordan and his ULTRA-MAGA agenda that we deserve leaders committed to preserving our democracy's checks and balances. Contribute today to elect representatives who will uphold our democratic values and ensure that no president can undermine the principles our nation was built on. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/tamie-wilson-for-us-c2g?refcode=20240713_trump_supreme_court_link1]
As your next Congresswoman, I will champion a balanced, fair judiciary that is truly representative of our nation's diversity and values.
Recent events have shown us how important this is:
We've seen Supreme Court justices being swayed by gifts, insider trading, and lavish vacations, raising serious questions about their impartiality and integrity.
This undermines the very foundation of our judicial system and erodes public trust in the courts.
The truth is that electing more Democrats to Congress is essential to preserve the checks and balances that safeguard our democracy.
Only a Congress with a Democratic majority can act as a counterbalance to any administration, ensuring that judicial appointments are fair and just rather than politically motivated.
This is especially true when it comes to future Supreme Court nominations.
We cannot allow the highest court in the land to be filled with justices who prioritize personal gain over justice and the rule of law.
By electing representatives who value integrity and accountability, we can restore faith in our judicial system and ensure that it serves the interests of all Americans, not just a privileged few.
I'm committed to making our courts serve everyone, not just the privileged.
Your contribution will help us build a Congress that will fight for our rights and protect our democracy. Let’s make sure the Supreme Court remains a guardian of justice. Contribute to our campaign today and join the fight for a fair and balanced judiciary. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/tamie-wilson-for-us-c2g?refcode=20240713_trump_supreme_court_link2]

Tamie Wilson

name: Heidi Ganahl

body:
Your daily rundown of REAL news for REAL Coloradans.
| | | | [](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
---
**PRESENTED BY[ROCKYMOUNTAINVOICE.COM](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
| | Hi everyone!
Hope you are having a great weekend in our beautiful state despite the high temps! A special shout-out to Jennie Suchocki, happy belated birthday on July 12th from all of us at RMV! Want a special shoutout on your special? Reply with your name/birthday to be featured.
This is the Mountain Minute for Saturday, July 13, 2024.
– Heidi Ganahl
---
|
---
| | **TODAY'S TOP STORIES**
---
**[‘Uncertainty’ hits Boulder Valley S.D. amid enrollment decline, new funding law and tax cap measure](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [BOULDER REPORTING LAB](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
[](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
The Boulder Valley School District is set to spend over $550 million on operating expenditures next school year. In lockstep with declining enrollment, fixed costs continue to rise, increasing the cost per student. Boulder spends over $4,000 more per pupil than the state average of $15,000, with some schools allocating over $22,000 per student.
This yearly enrollment decline of 1.5%, combined with a new funding law and a November 2024 ballot measure to cap property taxes — a major revenue source for BVSD — has sparked concerns about the district’s future budget. Although the new funding law may provide additional state aid, this will be offset by declining enrollment unless the district manages to reduce fixed costs. One potential solution is to shut down schools, raising anxiety that this may be in BVSD’s future.
“Uncertainty is not a great place to be,” Bill Sutter, the district’s chief financial officer, said in an interview.

**[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
|
---
**[Four takeaways from the ‘Big Boy’ presser Biden used to try and save his candidac](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)[y]()** [WASHINGTON EXAMINER](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
* Despite attempts to reassure Democrats of his capability during a press conference following a problematic debate performance, President Joe Biden faced ongoing questions about his fitness and candidacy, with some Democrats urging him to step down.
* Biden expressed strong resolve to remain in the presidential race, emphasizing his readiness to handle national and international issues, and his conviction that he is the most qualified Democrat to defeat Donald Trump.
* While Biden's foreign policy responses were highlights of the press conference, gaffes and misstatements contributed to lingering doubts among some party members, though he reiterated his support for Vice President Kamala Harris as a capable successor if necessary.

**[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
|
---
**[In Elbert County, manager and attorney get 40% pay increases, with perks](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** **** [COLORADO POLITICS](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
* Elbert County, Colorado, has increased the salaries of its County Manager and County Attorney to $220,000 each, along with additional perks, aligning their pay with market rates.
* The salary increases have raised concerns among residents, given the county's small population and the substantial raises compared to similar-sized counties.
* The county justifies the raises by citing the complexity of the officials' roles and the need for continuity ahead of upcoming changes in the board of commissioners, though residents question the transparency and timing of these decisions.

**[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
|
---
**[Aurora police preparing to roll out auto theft tracking program](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [DENVER GAZETTE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
* The Aurora Police Department is introducing a new program called Metro Track, developed in collaboration with the Colorado Auto Theft Prevention Agency, to enable the tracking and recovery of stolen cars using GPS technology and Apple AirTags for older models.
* Vehicle owners can voluntarily register for Metro Track without a fee, allowing police to track their vehicles if stolen, with the program set to officially launch at the end of July.
* Metro Track aims to deter car theft by providing registered car owners with stickers indicating that the vehicle is tracked by police, which has proven effective in Denver where no cars with stickers have been stolen since the program's inception.

**[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
|
---
**[State vet: 1.8 million head of poultry depopulated due to bird flu in Weld County](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [THE FENCE POST](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
* Colorado is managing a significant avian flu outbreak, with 1.8 million poultry depopulated in Weld County and the virus now threatening the dairy and poultry sectors.
* State Veterinarian Dr. Maggie Baldwin emphasized rigorous biosecurity and the critical importance of early disease reporting to mitigate spread and manage outbreaks.
* The outbreak has caused substantial disruptions, including decreased milk production and higher poultry mortality, but measures like pasteurization ensure dairy product safety and early intervention aids in controlling the disease's impact.

**[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
|
---
**[Boyd: Contrary to media claims, inflation index shows Americans still face sky-high prices](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [THE FEDERALIST](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.), COMMENTARY
_Contrary to the corporate media cabal’s desperate attempt to paint the Consumer Price Index report for June 2024 as a sign that inflation “cooled” and will continue “cooling” and “slowing” the closer the nation gets to November’s presidential election, Americans are still paying higher prices on basic day-to-day goods and services than they did in the last four years._
_When the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics released its latest inflation index showing a 0.1 percent decrease in prices from May 2024 to June 2024, press outlets and the Democrat regime rushed to bill the data as a sign that inflation is “at its lowest level in more than three years.”_
_The New York Times’ Paul Krugman, whose partisan commentary on American families’ financial straits is notoriously out of touch, claimed the CPI’s report means the record high prices that have plagued the nation are “plummeting.” CNN also framed the latest month-over-month data as “Good news for US consumers” because it indicated inflation “fell for the first time since the early part of the pandemic.”_
**[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
|

Jared Polis’s emergency declaration a public health measure or political maneuver for the White House?](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** **BY HEIDI GANAHL | COMMENTARY | JULY 11** []() _When Gov. Jared Polis declared a state of disaster in Colorado because of a surge in Highly Pathogenic Avian Influenza (HPAI), known commonly as bird flu, it ignited both a mix of public concern and political debate._
**_[Ashbaugh: How a Latino Democrat and a Black Republican opened a white, middle-aged woman’s eyes](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)_** **BY ERIN ASHBAUGH | COMMENTARY | JULY 10** _“I’m a Republican.” he said. “Ohhhh, I never pegged you to be that. I don’t think we can be friends anymore,” I laughed, only half-kidding. I was what one would consider a “Far Left” Democrat living in Boulder, CO when I said this, and Republicans were “the enemy.”_
**[Dion: Colorado Republicans, it’s time to unite and fight](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** **BY JAMESON DION | STATE | JULY 9** _In Colorado, Republican Party politics has been defined in recent years by losses, infighting and a steady decline in the percentage of Colorado voters that affiliate with the party._

body:
U.S. Intelligence says Russia’s efforts to influence this year’s U.S. election through information warfare have the same aim as in previous elections — to undermine President Joe Biden’s campaign and the Democratic Party and weaken public confidence in the electoral process,

[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/88833741/485291218/2130526953?refcode=emwrapper&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTkvMS8xMDc4NzgiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiZGVlOTllZjQtNDE0MS1lZjExLTg2YzMtNjA0NWJkZDllMDk2IiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=_EGcFvTSj0A1tJs9bT_0_Bf2asCLIU9trzOGX-EnAZ4=&emci=472f72ee-4141-ef11-86c3-6045bdd9e096&emdi=dee99ef4-4141-ef11-86c3-6045bdd9e096&ceid=14016711)
Peter,
With less than four months until election day, U.S. intelligence officials say Russia is gearing up for a massive election interference campaign to help Donald Trump.
According to a new report, Russia is using covert social media accounts to target key voters in swing states, hoping to erode support for Democrats, bolster their war in Ukraine, and build support for Trump ahead of the election.
**It’s the same operation they used in 2016 but on a much larger, more sophisticated scale.**
**[We’ll tell you more about Russia’s plan in a moment, but if you’re ready to help COURIER fight misinformation on social media, can you chip in $20 now?](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/88833745/485291223/-593472309?refcode=20240713-EM-RussianInterference&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTkvMS8xMDc4NzgiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiZGVlOTllZjQtNDE0MS1lZjExLTg2YzMtNjA0NWJkZDllMDk2IiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=_EGcFvTSj0A1tJs9bT_0_Bf2asCLIU9trzOGX-EnAZ4=)**
In 2016, the intelligence community concluded that Vladimir Putin used social media to sway American public opinion in favor of Donald Trump.
Russia is planning the same large-scale misinformation campaign this time around, but this time utilizing new AI technology including “bot farms” to rapidly create fake content that looks particularly real. Russia could even create deep fakes of politicians.
Plus, their targeting has improved. With nearly a decade of experience in sowing discord on social media, **Russia has learned how to show its messages to specific voter demographics so they can shape the outcome of our elections.**
So that’s the bad news. But the good news is that we’re already fighting back.
This is what COURIER was made for. We meet our audiences where they’re most likely to encounter Russian misinformation – on social media news feeds and in email inboxes. By correcting the record and providing truthful, impactful reporting about issues voters actually care about, they’re less likely to fall for the lies and conspiracy theories spread by bad actors like Russia.

clean_body: U.S. Intelligence says Russia’s efforts to influence this year’s U.S. election through information warfare have the same aim as in previous elections — to undermine President Joe Biden’s campaign and the Democratic Party and weaken public confidence in the electoral process, Peter, With less than four months until election day, U.S. intelligence officials say Russia is gearing up for a massive election interference campaign to help Donald Trump. According to a new report, Russia is using covert social media accounts to target key voters in swing states, hoping to erode support for Democrats, bolster their war in Ukraine, and build support for Trump ahead of the election. It’s the same operation they used in 2016 but on a much larger, more sophisticated scale. = In 2016, the intelligence community concluded that Vladimir Putin used social media to sway American public opinion in favor of Donald Trump. Russia is planning the same large-scale misinformation campaign this time around, but this time utilizing new AI technology including “bot farms” to rapidly create fake content that looks particularly real. Russia could even create deep fakes of politicians. Plus, their targeting has improved. With nearly a decade of experience in sowing discord on social media, Russia has learned how to show its messages to specific voter demographics so they can shape the outcome of our elections. So that’s the bad news. But the good news is that we’re already fighting back. This is what COURIER was made for. We meet our audiences where they’re most likely to encounter Russian misinformation – on social media news feeds and in email inboxes. | _Please see a special message from our sponsor. [](http://links.newsletter.conservativedirect.com/u/click?_t=5b1853ae48754bee8f471363fe4933a9&_m=b395df0052e845d3a4b26321cc4bf590&_e=WZ9tj71DFfiF-PDFjtIYKpy2tKEESzJZ69w7hi9UHJHgpg8fbpR6RurKlbSp2Z2qIlrQ0481RYd5neoA7j5gqU5YSsUFkR0fbxKPZ3U5R7Tksm0-HDzgUEmPjMFCGjrU0f_jq2tfqjA27vuTfXICZ_2_3S4Q86cwrv6Urerbd883kMvjSxA6BHoFspOcgKMDBweQ0o_oISA77Mgm6YBnsoJoickuBv_gWXSrU5I5rHKTbVNtYrvtjmOUdH_xowQ2JdfcVrMoL_qUKG-7dwwg9kbUG-I_yJ-T_fpLTw7rue34v-5WWc_vcohhseR_u_qJaFYzTCptLLguNHlfQ5wPNRmDe0jbbjNdUau1cz2V9grvijYRTlRo9ZETheTgssXX6lrs5rThBxLaqaCWyc4lkw%3D%3D)

Dear Friend,

Before you move on to your next email--I would appreciate it if you would take a few moments to participate in Hillsdale College's **National Survey on the Department of Justice.**

The survey has only eight questions, and its subject affects your liberty and the very survival of the rule of law in America.

**The current administration 's weaponization of the Department of Justice is unprecedented in American history.**

Instead of protecting your God-given constitutional rights, the administration uses the Department of Justice to attack its political opponents...

...as well as Christians, parents, and anyone who dares to stand up for our constitutional liberties.

At the same time, with the help of the media it...

* Covers up a two-tiered justice system that violates your constitutional rights
* Hides the corruption of the ruling class
* Attacks those with traditional viewpoints

**That 's why I'm asking you to take the Hillsdale College National Survey on the Department of Justice.**

By completing this survey, you will help us more clearly understand the views of mainstream Americans like you on this critical issue. Your responses will help Hillsdale strengthen its nationwide educational outreach efforts on behalf of liberty--including the importance of the rule of law and checks and balances, which the American Founders saw as essential safeguards against corruption.

Friend, you can complete the National Survey on the Department of Justice by using the link below:

**[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/department-of-justice-survey/](http://links.newsletter.conservativedirect.com/u/click?_t=5b1853ae48754bee8f471363fe4933a9&_m=b395df0052e845d3a4b26321cc4bf590&_e=WZ9tj71DFfiF-PDFjtIYKpy2tKEESzJZ69w7hi9UHJHgpg8fbpR6RurKlbSp2Z2qIlrQ0481RYd5neoA7j5gqU5YSsUFkR0fbxKPZ3U5R7Tksm0-HDzgUEmPjMFCGjrU0f_jq2tfqjA27vuTfXICZ_2_3S4Q86cwrv6Urerbd883kMvjSxA6BHoFspOcgKMDBweQ0o_oISA77Mgm6YBnsoJoickuBv_gWXSrU5I5rHLf7E3bYz_9cYphXQz1Vh4l8Vfh8wdp1nQSy6j0gBN7eu3JxVmb82VJ_RcMJM0s2fUBaM-U4I8U8GmQnrtCORua4TH9tJDPyoIgVHIj2lnYG-E-bWCSb90lrAVrkcFxCVtmc_BQmRzkW0SLP27MktwFM1HhxDYkb27xljprEWOFHw%3D%3D)**

The **Declaration of Independence** argues that **the purpose of just government is to secure our natural rights** and that **just government is founded on the consent of the governed.**

Yet today's ruling class regularly disregards the will of the American people, and our rights--to the freedoms of speech, assembly, and religion, to due process, to gun ownership, and more--are under constant attack.

**You and I know that liberty in America is under serious threat. But as I travel around the country, I tell the audiences I speak to how we are engaging in the fight against this threat.**

A vital part of our efforts in this fight--in which Hillsdale College is a leader--is **reaching** and **teaching** millions of citizens, with the TRUTH about America's great heritage of liberty.

We are heavily invested in our educational outreach efforts through our **Project to Defend Liberty Nationwide by Reaching and Teaching Millions.**

These efforts include:

* **Teaching bright and principled students** --on our campuses in Hillsdale, Michigan, and Washington, D.C.--who receive a rigorous, **classical liberal arts education, including** a required course on the Constitution
* **Distributing _Imprimis_** , America's leading digest of liberty, which is mailed to more than 6.4 million homes and businesses ten times per year; previous issues include "The Politicization of the Department of Justice" by Harmeet K. Dhillon
* **Producing and promoting free online courses** for any citizen who wishes to learn, on topics such as the Constitution, American history, and free market economics
* **Providing a classical K-12 curriculum** with a solid grounding in American history, constitutional government, and economics to schools that educate thousands of students nationwide

After everything we've seen over the past few years, the need for Hillsdale's educational outreach efforts is undeniable.

So please share your views by completing our **National Survey on the Department of Justice** and returning it to me as soon as possible. It only has eight questions and will take a few minutes of your time.

Your completed survey will help us form the most effective strategy to **reach** and **teach** millions of Americans on behalf of liberty.

As you might know, Hillsdale College is almost unique in American higher education in its refusal to accept EVEN ONE PENNY of government funding--not even indirectly in the form of federal or state student grants or loans.

**This independence frees the College from burdensome and corrupting government regulations. But it also means that our work depends entirely on the generous support of private citizens, like you, who understand the importance of education to liberty.**

If you agree that we are now seeing an unprecedented assault on the American way of life, I hope you will partner with Hillsdale College by making a generous tax-deductible gift today. You can easily do so after completing the attached **National Survey on the Department of Justice** , which you can access at this secure link:

**[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/department-of-justice-survey/](http://links.newsletter.conservativedirect.com/u/click?_t=5b1853ae48754bee8f471363fe4933a9&_m=b395df0052e845d3a4b26321cc4bf590&_e=WZ9tj71DFfiF-PDFjtIYKpy2tKEESzJZ69w7hi9UHJHgpg8fbpR6RurKlbSp2Z2qIlrQ0481RYd5neoA7j5gqU5YSsUFkR0fbxKPZ3U5R7Tksm0-HDzgUEmPjMFCGjrU0f_jq2tfqjA27vuTfXICZ_2_3S4Q86cwrv6Urerbd883kMvjSxA6BHoFspOcgKMDBweQ0o_oISA77Mgm6YBnsoJoickuBv_gWXSrU5I5rHKFuKPI6vFvkllPyY9gP-Yl0J8TLsKV0jt9MyPxsL6vp4wuLJDTvxNRm9lqf8wZru3geZ-OM9m066FUORJazgO-vNJIUwLfsDPNEECNrNgaPdBFAGc8MxVAVljSHpn-WP-4-KvD295C3G7nDqXlUeOGMOoy3_tQ-2eoQMAntkN35Q%3D%3D)**

Thank you for your time and attention. I look forward to receiving your completed survey, and I sincerely appreciate your support of Hillsdale's educational outreach efforts on behalf of liberty.

Warm regards,

Larry P. Arnn
President, Hillsdale College
Pursuing Truth and Defending Liberty Since 1844

Covers up a two-tiered justice system that violates your constitutional rights Hides the corruption of the ruling class Attacks those with traditional viewpoints That 's why I'm asking you to take the Hillsdale College National Survey on the Department of Justice. By completing this survey, you will help us more clearly understand the views of mainstream Americans like you on this critical issue. Your responses will help Hillsdale strengthen its nationwide educational outreach efforts on behalf of liberty--including the importance of the rule of law and checks and balances, which the American Founders saw as essential safeguards against corruption. Friend, you can complete the National Survey on the Department of Justice by using the link below: The Declaration of Independence argues that the purpose of just government is to secure our natural rights and that just government is founded on the consent of the governed. Yet today's ruling class regularly disregards the will of the American people, and our rights--to the freedoms of speech, assembly, and religion, to due process, to gun ownership, and more--are under constant attack. You and I know that liberty in America is under serious threat. But as I travel around the country, I tell the audiences I speak to how we are engaging in the fight against this threat. A vital part of our efforts in this fight--in which Hillsdale College is a leader--is reaching and teaching millions of citizens, with the TRUTH about America's great heritage of liberty. We are heavily invested in our educational outreach efforts through our Project to Defend Liberty Nationwide by Reaching and Teaching Millions. These efforts include: Teaching bright and principled students --on our campuses in Hillsdale, Michigan, and Washington, D.C.--who receive a rigorous, classical liberal arts education, including a required course on the Constitution Distributing Imprimis , America's leading digest of liberty, which is mailed to more than 6.4 million homes and businesses ten times per year; previous issues include "The Politicization of the Department of Justice" by Harmeet K. Dhillon Producing and promoting free online courses for any citizen who wishes to learn, on topics such as the Constitution, American history, and free market economics Providing a classical K-12 curriculum with a solid grounding in American history, constitutional government, and economics to schools that educate thousands of students nationwide After everything we've seen over the past few years, the need for Hillsdale's educational outreach efforts is undeniable. So please share your views by completing our National Survey on the Department of Justice and returning it to me as soon as possible. It only has eight questions and will take a few minutes of your time. Your completed survey will help us form the most effective strategy to reach and teach millions of Americans on behalf of liberty. As you might know, Hillsdale College is almost unique in American higher education in its refusal to accept EVEN ONE PENNY of government funding--not even indirectly in the form of federal or state student grants or loans. This independence frees the College from burdensome and corrupting government regulations. But it also means that our work depends entirely on the generous support of private citizens, like you, who understand the importance of education to liberty. If you agree that we are now seeing an unprecedented assault on the American way of life, I hope you will partner with Hillsdale College by making a generous tax-deductible gift today. You can easily do so after completing the attached National Survey on the Department of Justice , which you can access at this secure link: ** Thank you for your time and attention. I look forward to receiving your completed survey, and I sincerely appreciate your support of Hillsdale's educational outreach efforts on behalf of liberty. Warm regards, Larry P. body:
Your inbox is probably full of campaign emails right now. I want to take a moment to explain why Truth to Power is different.
# [](https://act.katieporter.com/go/9?t=1&akid=38983%2E3422442%2EF8GnjX)
Derek—it’s Katie Porter.
We’re a few months away from a critical election day. That probably means that your inbox is full of fundraising emails from campaigns, candidates, and committees from across the country.
I’m sure some of them are good, ethical emails. But I’m also sure that some of them are... a little sketchy.
**As a consumer protection attorney, there’s a lot I’ve always disliked about political emails** —which is why we’ve never sent you anything about a bogus “3x match” or any fake math about the “5 donors we **NEED** from your zip code right now.”
Maybe the worst offenders are the emails that try to scare or intimidate you into donating. Often, they’re sent by groups you’ve never heard of before, with names chock-full of buzzwords like “democracy” or “victory” or “America.”
These groups are rarely transparent about who they are or how they spend your money. Sometimes, they’re “scam PACs,” which is a type of political organization that claims to support important causes but actually funnels donations into consultants’ pockets. I hate scam PACs.
**I want to take a moment to explain why Truth to Power isn't like that.** We’re not an amorphous void, where your money disappears untraceably and somehow saves democracy.
Truth to Power is a specific organization, with a specific goal. We endorse candidates for Congress who will champion the fight against corporate money in politics once elected.
We use your contributions to support their campaigns, fighting back against interference from dark money groups. Too often, candidates who refuse to accept money from corporate interests lose their races because they cannot close the fundraising gap with their corporate-backed opponents. **Truth to Power exists to stop that from happening.**
In about six months, my time in Congress will come to an end. But, our movement is far from over—with your help, we will elect leaders who will build on my work, carrying on the fight against special interests and corporate influence in the halls of power.
**[Election day is getting closer, and our fight is ramping up. So, if you can, please consider making a contribution to Truth to Power today.](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/ttp-em-20240713?refcode=em20240713-38983&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&refcode2=38983_3422442_F8GnjX&akid=38983%2E3422442%2EF8GnjX)**

Thanks for reading, and thanks for supporting our work. I am honored to have you in my corner.
—Katie

Update on CA wildfires

| [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/88836426/485300218/-1463099547?refcode=-header-&amount=25&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMjQvMS8xMDMxMTgiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiMzU1MzBjMmEtNGE0MS1lZjExLTg2YzMtNjA0NWJkZDllMDk2IiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=JFvhmXbrT2VRNVhn3qXlDfbUfU8OD3JVc-thj-A_uI4=) | Peter, I wanted to take a moment to talk about something that’s been weighing heavily on my mind: California’s wildfires. Recently, the Corral Fire in San Joaquin County came within a mile of my house - we could see and smell the smoke. It was very scary. The fire ended up burning over 14,000 acres and our fire departments were stretched incredibly thin. I wish I could say this was the first time wildfires threatened my community. But unfortunately here in California, wildfire season has turned into a year-round threat. **And it’s only getting worse. This year wildfires are spreading faster and burning longer.** In fact, fires are burning 4x more land this year compared to last. I’m deeply concerned. That’s why I fought and won a pay increase for our wildland firefighters. **And it’s why I just introduced our landmark bill: the Modernizing Wildfire Safety and Prevention Act.** This first-in-its-kind bill will revolutionize how we fight and prevent wildfires. It enhances firefighter training, updates technology to better predict wildfires, and gets our fire services the tools and services they need to get fires under control quickly. **I truly believe in this bill.** And I hope you’ll consider adding your name as a citizen co-sponsor. We need to show DC that this issue matters! Here’s the link: [https://secure.ngpvan.com/sign](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/88836427/485300246/-922350157?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMjQvMS8xMDMxMTgiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiMzU1MzBjMmEtNGE0MS1lZjExLTg2YzMtNjA0NWJkZDllMDk2IiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=JFvhmXbrT2VRNVhn3qXlDfbUfU8OD3JVc-thj-A_uI4=&emci=8398b1fe-7938-ef11-86d2-6045bdd9e096&emdi=35530c2a-4a41-ef11-86c3-6045bdd9e096&ceid=6455652) We’ve got a tough road ahead, but I believe climate change is an existential crisis. We have to keep pushing and actually fight back! \- Josh

# Paper Ballots Across the Nation
### Our elections are at stake!!
| | | [Dan Carr](https://substack.com/@dancarr2014)
---
| Jul 13
---
| [](https://substack.com/@dancarr2014)
---
[](https://substack.com/redirect/12adef46-40fd-48f3-b6b3-90b316e0173c?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
In a world increasingly dominated by technology, it's crucial to remember the importance of hand ballots in our electoral process. Here's why they matter:
1. **Security** : Hand ballots reduce the risk of hacking and ensure that every vote is counted accurately.
2. **Accessibility** : They provide a reliable option for voters who may not trust electronic systems or have limited access to technology.
3. **Transparency** : The physical nature of hand ballots allows for better verification and transparency in the voting process.
4. **Voter Confidence** : Knowing that their vote is cast on a tangible ballot can increase voter confidence and participation.

Let's continue to advocate for voting methods that uphold the integrity of our democracy! #HandBallots #VoteWithConfidence #VotingMatters

body:
Back when I was that kid sleeping on the floor of our apartment, I never could’ve guessed this is how things would turn out. When I was a Marine in Iraq, I never could’ve guessed that I’d have to fight to defend our democracy at home. |
---
Hola, Peter. It’s Ruben.

You might be wondering how this kid...
[](https://click.everyaction.com/k/88838065/485306184/-495282819?refcode=DR_SPLIT_FR_90DO_240713_1_2&amount=25&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAwNi8xLzg1ODM1IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjg0Njk0MThlLTUyNDEtZWYxMS04NmMzLTYwNDViZGQ5ZTA5NiIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=9fMlvO9SLQWY79Y9KrXAukjC31H1XbDESwkM9HT5Zp0=)
...ended up here, running for U.S. Senate, in one of the most competitive races in the entire country.
[](https://click.everyaction.com/k/88838066/485306185/-495282819?refcode=DR_SPLIT_FR_90DO_240713_1_2&amount=25&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAwNi8xLzg1ODM1IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjg0Njk0MThlLTUyNDEtZWYxMS04NmMzLTYwNDViZGQ5ZTA5NiIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=9fMlvO9SLQWY79Y9KrXAukjC31H1XbDESwkM9HT5Zp0=)
Well, it started back in the apartment I shared with my mom and my sisters after our dad left. It was tough. I was sleeping on the floor because that’s all we could afford.
[](https://click.everyaction.com/k/88838068/485306187/-495282819?refcode=DR_SPLIT_FR_90DO_240713_1_2&amount=25&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAwNi8xLzg1ODM1IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjg0Njk0MThlLTUyNDEtZWYxMS04NmMzLTYwNDViZGQ5ZTA5NiIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=9fMlvO9SLQWY79Y9KrXAukjC31H1XbDESwkM9HT5Zp0=)
I knew I had to do whatever it took to build a better life for us. I worked a bunch of jobs all through school to help make ends meet.
[](https://click.everyaction.com/k/88838071/485306190/-495282819?refcode=DR_SPLIT_FR_90DO_240713_1_2&amount=25&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAwNi8xLzg1ODM1IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjg0Njk0MThlLTUyNDEtZWYxMS04NmMzLTYwNDViZGQ5ZTA5NiIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=9fMlvO9SLQWY79Y9KrXAukjC31H1XbDESwkM9HT5Zp0=)
Thanks to my family, my community, and a lot of hard work, I got into college. But before I graduated, I enlisted in the Marines to serve the country that gave me so much.
[](https://click.everyaction.com/k/88838074/485306193/-495282819?refcode=DR_SPLIT_FR_90DO_240713_1_2&amount=25&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAwNi8xLzg1ODM1IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjg0Njk0MThlLTUyNDEtZWYxMS04NmMzLTYwNDViZGQ5ZTA5NiIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=9fMlvO9SLQWY79Y9KrXAukjC31H1XbDESwkM9HT5Zp0=)
I deployed to Al Anbar, Iraq with my brothers in arms. They called us “Lucky Lima”, but our luck turned eventually. We ended up the hardest Marine hit unit of the entire Iraq war, and I lost some of my best friends over there.
[](https://click.everyaction.com/k/88838077/485306196/-495282819?refcode=DR_SPLIT_FR_90DO_240713_1_2&amount=25&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAwNi8xLzg1ODM1IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjg0Njk0MThlLTUyNDEtZWYxMS04NmMzLTYwNDViZGQ5ZTA5NiIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=9fMlvO9SLQWY79Y9KrXAukjC31H1XbDESwkM9HT5Zp0=)
You’re never the same person after something like that. And I knew I had to do something to improve things for the guys I served with, for people who grew up like me. So, I ended up running for Congress — and I won.
[](https://click.everyaction.com/k/88838079/485306199/-495282819?refcode=DR_SPLIT_FR_90DO_240713_1_2&amount=25&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAwNi8xLzg1ODM1IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjg0Njk0MThlLTUyNDEtZWYxMS04NmMzLTYwNDViZGQ5ZTA5NiIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=9fMlvO9SLQWY79Y9KrXAukjC31H1XbDESwkM9HT5Zp0=)
Then, on January 6th, everything changed. It became clear to me that public service wasn’t just about improving the lives of the people in my community anymore — it was about defending our democracy, too.
[](https://click.everyaction.com/k/88838083/485306201/-495282819?refcode=DR_SPLIT_FR_90DO_240713_1_2&amount=25&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAwNi8xLzg1ODM1IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjg0Njk0MThlLTUyNDEtZWYxMS04NmMzLTYwNDViZGQ5ZTA5NiIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=9fMlvO9SLQWY79Y9KrXAukjC31H1XbDESwkM9HT5Zp0=)
So now, I’m running for U.S. Senate. My opponent Kari Lake continues to spread the same lies and conspiracies that caused January 6th in the first place, and she’s one of the greatest threats to our democracy — after Trump himself.
[](https://click.everyaction.com/k/88838085/485306205/-495282819?refcode=DR_SPLIT_FR_90DO_240713_1_2&amount=25&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAwNi8xLzg1ODM1IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjg0Njk0MThlLTUyNDEtZWYxMS04NmMzLTYwNDViZGQ5ZTA5NiIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=9fMlvO9SLQWY79Y9KrXAukjC31H1XbDESwkM9HT5Zp0=)
Back when I was that kid sleeping on the floor of our apartment, I never would’ve guessed this is how things would turn out.

When I was a Marine in Iraq, I never would’ve thought I’d have to fight to defend our democracy at home.

When I launched my first campaign, I never would’ve imagined that hundreds of thousands of people would back me up and donate to support me, either.

And I never, ever would’ve thought I’d need to ask supporters like you, people who have already done so much, to do a bit more. But to defeat Kari Lake and win in Arizona, that’s what I have to do.

I need you to do a bit more.

[Please — if you can afford to make a split donation of $25 or anything you can to my campaign and Defeat Republicans, it would mean the world. A fundraising deadline is right around the corner, and we’ve got a ton of progress to make on our goals between now and then. ](https://click.everyaction.com/k/88838087/485306207/-495282819?refcode=DR_SPLIT_FR_90DO_240713_1_2&amount=25&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAwNi8xLzg1ODM1IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjg0Njk0MThlLTUyNDEtZWYxMS04NmMzLTYwNDViZGQ5ZTA5NiIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=9fMlvO9SLQWY79Y9KrXAukjC31H1XbDESwkM9HT5Zp0=)

Ruben

name: Hassan Martini
subject: Political Violence Can Never Be Accepted
body:
| | | | | |
---
| | | | This is going to be one of those moments we remember for the rest of our lives. I was in the grocery store when the woman behind me started to shout out the news and I didn't pay too much attention, yet suddenly my phone started buzzing and it didn't stop. Political violence is on the rise globally, yet here in America, we assume that kind of stuff doesn't happen anymore. Today we were reminded it can happen to us because it did. Regardless of how you feel about the former President, we all should be relieved that he is ok. The idea of what could have happened if the worst-case scenario took place sends shivers down my spine. I am not going to discuss the political ramifications of today's act, all you have to do is open up Twitter and you can see how some folks are reacting President Obama is someone we can always turn to in a moment of crisis and this is what he had to say. "There is absolutely no place for political violence in our democracy. Although we don’t yet know exactly what happened, we should all be relieved that former President Trump wasn’t seriously hurt, and use this moment to recommit ourselves to civility and respect in our politics. Michelle and I are wishing him a quick recovery." What comes next is anyone's guess, we are living in unchartered territory. I will say this, hug your families tonight and do your best to reach out to those you don't always see eye to eye with on political matters. We must use this moment to heal, we have to do better because the alternative is not something we want to ever live through. When we first launched No Dem Left Behind 5 years ago one of our goals was the depolarization of America. Unfortunately, that is not something we have succeeded in yet, but this is going to serve as a reminder that we can never stop trying. All we can do is do better. We have a lot of work to do. I will be honest right now we are all feeling a bit overwhelmed, so let's take this weekend to just decompress. I will follow up early next week, as I am sure there will be plenty to share with you. Hassan Martini

name: Jill Stein
subject: How to make a genocide invisible
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Jill Stein for President 2024
body:
Bombs and bullets are not the only weapons in this “war.”

| | | [ ](https://www.jillstein2024.com/?e=e813143e1dc0d3b0ffcb007ffe357333&utm_source=jillsteinforpresident&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=gaza_death_toll&n=1)
---
Peter,

A new report from the British medical journal, _The Lancet_ , estimates that the death toll in Gaza could reach 186,000.

The world was shocked by this figure, but I am not.

This new expert assessment is in line with the figures our friend Ralph Nader put forward earlier this year when he estimated as many as 200,000 have been killed by Israel in Gaza.

**As a medical doctor and a lifelong antiwar activist, I know all too well that bombs and bullets are not the only weapons that kill in war.

** From the beginning, the **Israeli occupation forces have weaponized hunger and disease** by choking off food, electricity, and water. They have intentionally bombed and raided hospitals, **set drones to take out ambulances** trying to retrieve the wounded, and withheld or destroyed medical supplies.

Israeli forces have collapsed entire apartment buildings full of frightened families and continue to fire on schools. When they forced the last Gazans into crowded, tent-city refugee camps in one tiny corner of the strip – **they even bombed the tents.

** We’ve ALWAYS known the death toll published by the Gaza Health Ministry was lower than the real number. And with good reason. The GHM numbers are simply the confirmed, recorded deaths documented in hospitals and morgues.
---
[ ](https://www.jillstein2024.com/donate?e=e813143e1dc0d3b0ffcb007ffe357333&utm_source=jillsteinforpresident&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=gaza_death_toll&n=2)
---
What we also know is that, at every step, Israel has sought to decimate Gaza’s infrastructure and deny them the chance to survive by any means at all. And we don’t have to guess at their intent – they’ve told us, repeatedly.

**_“We are fighting against human animals.”_** _– Israeli Defense Minister Yoav Gallant

_** _“Turn the Gaza Strip into a slaughterhouse.”_** _– Israeli filmmaker Anat Schwartz

_** _“Erasing all of Gaza from the face of the earth.”_** _– Israeli MP Distel Atbaryan

_ Today, at least 1.1 million Gazans are facing famine and disease, all while the bombs continue to rain down.

**The assessment that Israel’s genocide will snuff out 186,000 Palestinians is a shock to our collective conscience as a human race.** It’s impossible to weigh the enormity of the grief and loss the Palestinian people will carry forward.

We cannot measure the toll of their trauma, the cost of lost human potential taken by Israel’s barbarism – or the guilt we will carry for our own government’s complicity. **[What we can do is let this galvanize our resolve and our commitment to justice for Palestine. Ours is the ONLY anti-genocide, pro-peace, pro-planet, pro-worker campaign that is fighting to be on the ballot across the country November 5th. Help me get our campaign in front of every voter who supports a ceasefire and lasting peace with justice.](https://www.jillstein2024.com/donate?e=e813143e1dc0d3b0ffcb007ffe357333&utm_source=jillsteinforpresident&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=gaza_death_toll&n=3)**
---
| [](https://www.jillstein2024.com/donate?e=e813143e1dc0d3b0ffcb007ffe357333&utm_source=jillsteinforpresident&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=gaza_death_toll&n=4 "DONATE") [DONATE](https://www.jillstein2024.com/donate?e=e813143e1dc0d3b0ffcb007ffe357333&utm_source=jillsteinforpresident&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=gaza_death_toll&n=4)
---
No one could weigh the full body of evidence and say with honesty and conviction that they believe the numbers reported by the Gaza Health Ministry represent the full picture of the death and devastation wrought by Israel.

**But Democrats and Republicans are not satisfied with the drastic undercount of the confirmed figures from the most reliable source of this data. They want to erase Israel’s genocide completely.

** Two weeks ago, the House passed a bill on a broad bipartisan basis that would forbid the Biden administration from citing death statistics from the Gaza Health Ministry – figures that even Israeli officials rely on for their own intelligence assessments.

The Biden administration – indeed the president himself – have repeatedly undermined the credibility of the Gaza Health Ministry’s figures in order to cast doubt on the legitimacy of the suffering in Gaza.

Now they have license from the House to render it fully invisible.

**[We will not allow the beautiful souls of the Palestinian people to be reduced to rubble and statistics. Stand with me and make this campaign as strong as we can so we can deliver our mandate for people, planet, and peace on November 5th.](https://www.jillstein2024.com/donate?e=e813143e1dc0d3b0ffcb007ffe357333&utm_source=jillsteinforpresident&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=gaza_death_toll&n=5)**

As Gaza goes, we all go.

In solidarity and gratitude,

Jill

clean_body: Bombs and bullets are not the only weapons in this “war.” | | | Peter, A new report from the British medical journal, The Lancet , estimates that the death toll in Gaza could reach 186,000. The world was shocked by this figure, but I am not. This new expert assessment is in line with the figures our friend Ralph Nader put forward earlier this year when he estimated as many as 200,000 have been killed by Israel in Gaza. As a medical doctor and a lifelong antiwar activist, I know all too well that bombs and bullets are not the only weapons that kill in war. From the beginning, the Israeli occupation forces have weaponized hunger and disease by choking off food, electricity, and water. They have intentionally bombed and raided hospitals, set drones to take out ambulances trying to retrieve the wounded, and withheld or destroyed medical supplies. Israeli forces have collapsed entire apartment buildings full of frightened families and continue to fire on schools. When they forced the last Gazans into crowded, tent-city refugee camps in one tiny corner of the strip – they even bombed the tents. We’ve ALWAYS known the death toll published by the Gaza Health Ministry was lower than the real number. And with good reason. The GHM numbers are simply the confirmed, recorded deaths documented in hospitals and morgues. What we also know is that, at every step, Israel has sought to decimate Gaza’s infrastructure and deny them the chance to survive by any means at all. And we don’t have to guess at their intent – they’ve told us, repeatedly. “We are fighting against human animals.” – Israeli Defense Minister Yoav Gallant “Turn the Gaza Strip into a slaughterhouse.” – Israeli filmmaker Anat Schwartz “Erasing all of Gaza from the face of the earth.” – Israeli MP Distel Atbaryan Today, at least 1.1 million Gazans are facing famine and disease, all while the bombs continue to rain down. The assessment that Israel’s genocide will snuff out 186,000 Palestinians is a shock to our collective conscience as a human race. It’s impossible to weigh the enormity of the grief and loss the Palestinian people will carry forward. We cannot measure the toll of their trauma, the cost of lost human potential taken by Israel’s barbarism – or the guilt we will carry for our own government’s complicity. | "DONATE" No one could weigh the full body of evidence and say with honesty and conviction that they believe the numbers reported by the Gaza Health Ministry represent the full picture of the death and devastation wrought by Israel. But Democrats and Republicans are not satisfied with the drastic undercount of the confirmed figures from the most reliable source of this data. They want to erase Israel’s genocide completely. Two weeks ago, the House passed a bill on a broad bipartisan basis that would forbid the Biden administration from citing death statistics from the Gaza Health Ministry – figures that even Israeli officials rely on for their own intelligence assessments. The Biden administration – indeed the president himself – have repeatedly undermined the credibility of the Gaza Health Ministry’s figures in order to cast doubt on the legitimacy of the suffering in Gaza. Now they have license from the House to render it fully invisible. As Gaza goes, we all go. In solidarity and gratitude, Jill | "Support Jill Today!" Hey, y’all! There’s so much happening in Tennessee right now. Early voting for the August primaries is officially underway, and we’re just weeks out from the big day! Don’t forget to download the GoVoteTN app for early voting times, locations, and sample ballots. You can still register to vote at **[vote.org.](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/88840944/485316370/-1694523815?refcode=ea.1f5bb81e-5f41-ef11-86c3-6045bdd9e096&ms=ea.1f5bb81e-5f41-ef11-86c3-6045bdd9e096&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTAvMS84MDYxOSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIxZjViYjgxZS01ZjQxLWVmMTEtODZjMy02MDQ1YmRkOWUwOTYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=2oCZPpJUu2x1Z7hcYmB8imd5mv0cpqR66l5odvGdMDw=&emci=125cdfae-9440-ef11-86c3-6045bdd9e096&emdi=1f5bb81e-5f41-ef11-86c3-6045bdd9e096&ceid=46764483)** Nothing is more energizing than getting together with the people who make up this movement. I’m in this race because of you, and connecting in person makes all the hard days worth it. Check out some highlights from our recent events and see what else we’ve been up to lately 👇
* * *
🎆 4th of July Celebrations 🎆 We had an absolute blast on the 4th of July! The day started early as I joined many of the Knox Democrats for the Farragut 4th of July Parade. [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/88840945/485316371/209297649?refcode=ea.1f5bb81e-5f41-ef11-86c3-6045bdd9e096&ms=ea.1f5bb81e-5f41-ef11-86c3-6045bdd9e096&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTAvMS84MDYxOSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIxZjViYjgxZS01ZjQxLWVmMTEtODZjMy02MDQ1YmRkOWUwOTYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=2oCZPpJUu2x1Z7hcYmB8imd5mv0cpqR66l5odvGdMDw=) Team Gloria has 42 wonderful new interns statewide, and I got to hang out with some of them in Knox. They are so impressive!
* * *
🚫 Fighting for Contraception Access 🚫 [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/88840946/485316372/209297649?refcode=ea.1f5bb81e-5f41-ef11-86c3-6045bdd9e096&ms=ea.1f5bb81e-5f41-ef11-86c3-6045bdd9e096&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTAvMS84MDYxOSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIxZjViYjgxZS01ZjQxLWVmMTEtODZjMy02MDQ1YmRkOWUwOTYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=2oCZPpJUu2x1Z7hcYmB8imd5mv0cpqR66l5odvGdMDw=) Last month, Senate Republicans, including Marsha Blackburn, blocked a bill granting a federal right to birth control. So, I stood in protest with Senator Charlane Oliver and other colleagues in front of the Tennessee State Capitol — along with a giant 20-foot inflatable IUD. **_Yes, you read that right — a 20-foot inflatable IUD!_** [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/88840947/485316373/209297649?refcode=ea.1f5bb81e-5f41-ef11-86c3-6045bdd9e096&ms=ea.1f5bb81e-5f41-ef11-86c3-6045bdd9e096&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTAvMS84MDYxOSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIxZjViYjgxZS01ZjQxLWVmMTEtODZjMy02MDQ1YmRkOWUwOTYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=2oCZPpJUu2x1Z7hcYmB8imd5mv0cpqR66l5odvGdMDw=) **I also joined Joy Reid on MSNBC to talk about how Marsha Blackburn and the GOP are destroying our freedoms.** [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/88840949/485316374/901416524?refcode=ea.1f5bb81e-5f41-ef11-86c3-6045bdd9e096&ms=ea.1f5bb81e-5f41-ef11-86c3-6045bdd9e096&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTAvMS84MDYxOSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIxZjViYjgxZS01ZjQxLWVmMTEtODZjMy02MDQ1YmRkOWUwOTYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=2oCZPpJUu2x1Z7hcYmB8imd5mv0cpqR66l5odvGdMDw=&emci=125cdfae-9440-ef11-86c3-6045bdd9e096&emdi=1f5bb81e-5f41-ef11-86c3-6045bdd9e096&ceid=46764483) Let’s be honest, Marsha Blackburn was never going to stop with abortion. She and her Republican allies have always had one end goal: complete control over women’s bodies and our reproductive rights. Contraception changed everything for women, and I’ll be damned if we’re forced to go back. We have to kick Marsha and her extremist allies OUT of Washington if we’re going to protect access to birth control and restore abortion rights nationwide.
* * *
🎙️ Speaking Out Against Voter Suppression 🎙️ I joined Justin Kanew on the TN Holler podcast to talk about voter suppression and the recent GOP tactics in Tennessee. [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/88840951/485316377/-110938916?refcode=ea.1f5bb81e-5f41-ef11-86c3-6045bdd9e096&ms=ea.1f5bb81e-5f41-ef11-86c3-6045bdd9e096&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTAvMS84MDYxOSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIxZjViYjgxZS01ZjQxLWVmMTEtODZjMy02MDQ1YmRkOWUwOTYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=2oCZPpJUu2x1Z7hcYmB8imd5mv0cpqR66l5odvGdMDw=&emci=125cdfae-9440-ef11-86c3-6045bdd9e096&emdi=1f5bb81e-5f41-ef11-86c3-6045bdd9e096&ceid=46764483) In case you missed it, election officials sent letters to over 14,000 Tennesseans asking for proof of U.S. citizenship to vote. Let’s be clear: This isn’t about protecting the integrity of our elections. It’s about silencing us. It’s about making it harder for everyday Tennesseans, especially those from marginalized communities, to exercise their fundamental right to vote. **[If you missed the broadcast, you can check it out here.](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/88840953/485316379/951549037?refcode=ea.1f5bb81e-5f41-ef11-86c3-6045bdd9e096&ms=ea.1f5bb81e-5f41-ef11-86c3-6045bdd9e096&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTAvMS84MDYxOSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIxZjViYjgxZS01ZjQxLWVmMTEtODZjMy02MDQ1YmRkOWUwOTYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=2oCZPpJUu2x1Z7hcYmB8imd5mv0cpqR66l5odvGdMDw=&emci=125cdfae-9440-ef11-86c3-6045bdd9e096&emdi=1f5bb81e-5f41-ef11-86c3-6045bdd9e096&ceid=46764483)**
* * *
🏢 New Campaign Offices! 🏢 Big news, y'all! Last month we opened brand-new campaign offices in Memphis and Nashville! [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/88840955/485316381/209297649?refcode=ea.1f5bb81e-5f41-ef11-86c3-6045bdd9e096&ms=ea.1f5bb81e-5f41-ef11-86c3-6045bdd9e096&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTAvMS84MDYxOSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIxZjViYjgxZS01ZjQxLWVmMTEtODZjMy02MDQ1YmRkOWUwOTYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=2oCZPpJUu2x1Z7hcYmB8imd5mv0cpqR66l5odvGdMDw=) Here, we'll map out strategies, connect with volunteers, and push forward our vision for Tennessee. [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/88840957/485316383/209297649?refcode=ea.1f5bb81e-5f41-ef11-86c3-6045bdd9e096&ms=ea.1f5bb81e-5f41-ef11-86c3-6045bdd9e096&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTAvMS84MDYxOSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIxZjViYjgxZS01ZjQxLWVmMTEtODZjMy02MDQ1YmRkOWUwOTYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=2oCZPpJUu2x1Z7hcYmB8imd5mv0cpqR66l5odvGdMDw=) While Marsha Blackburn is busy clinking glasses with Donald Trump and cozying up to special interests down in Florida, I'm right here, on the ground, meeting with Tennesseans and discussing the real issues that affect our lives. [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/88840960/485316385/209297649?refcode=ea.1f5bb81e-5f41-ef11-86c3-6045bdd9e096&ms=ea.1f5bb81e-5f41-ef11-86c3-6045bdd9e096&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTAvMS84MDYxOSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIxZjViYjgxZS01ZjQxLWVmMTEtODZjMy02MDQ1YmRkOWUwOTYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=2oCZPpJUu2x1Z7hcYmB8imd5mv0cpqR66l5odvGdMDw=) Thank you to everyone who attended; your support means the world to me.
* * *
🔥 Unstoppable Women of Nashville 🔥 I am beyond honored to be featured in “The Unstoppable Women of Nashville” this month in Bitter Southerner’s all-women issue. They highlighted me for standing tall with the Tennessee Three for gun violence survivors and my effort to protect our communities in the state legislature. [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/88840964/485316415/209297649?refcode=ea.1f5bb81e-5f41-ef11-86c3-6045bdd9e096&ms=ea.1f5bb81e-5f41-ef11-86c3-6045bdd9e096&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTAvMS84MDYxOSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIxZjViYjgxZS01ZjQxLWVmMTEtODZjMy02MDQ1YmRkOWUwOTYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=2oCZPpJUu2x1Z7hcYmB8imd5mv0cpqR66l5odvGdMDw=) As your next senator, I will fight tooth and nail to pass common-sense gun legislation, come hell or high water.
* * *
🌈 Celebrating Pride Month 🌈 Last month was Pride Month, and we had an absolute blast at Nashville Pride! [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/88840966/485316419/209297649?refcode=ea.1f5bb81e-5f41-ef11-86c3-6045bdd9e096&ms=ea.1f5bb81e-5f41-ef11-86c3-6045bdd9e096&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTAvMS84MDYxOSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIxZjViYjgxZS01ZjQxLWVmMTEtODZjMy02MDQ1YmRkOWUwOTYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=2oCZPpJUu2x1Z7hcYmB8imd5mv0cpqR66l5odvGdMDw=) [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/88840968/485316421/209297649?refcode=ea.1f5bb81e-5f41-ef11-86c3-6045bdd9e096&ms=ea.1f5bb81e-5f41-ef11-86c3-6045bdd9e096&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTAvMS84MDYxOSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIxZjViYjgxZS01ZjQxLWVmMTEtODZjMy02MDQ1YmRkOWUwOTYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=2oCZPpJUu2x1Z7hcYmB8imd5mv0cpqR66l5odvGdMDw=) While we celebrate love in all its colors, let’s remember: this fight isn’t just about parades — it’s about protection. It’s about persistence. It’s about pushing back with everything we’ve got. Republicans like Marsha are trying to strip these freedoms away. I'm determined to pass the Equality Act when I am in the Senate.
* * *

clean_body: A few things you may have missed: | Hey, y’all! There’s so much happening in Tennessee right now. Early voting for the August primaries is officially underway, and we’re just weeks out from the big day! Don’t forget to download the GoVoteTN app for early voting times, locations, and sample ballots. You can still register to vote at Nothing is more energizing than getting together with the people who make up this movement. I’m in this race because of you, and connecting in person makes all the hard days worth it. Check out some highlights from our recent events and see what else we’ve been up to lately 👇 🎆 4th of July Celebrations 🎆 We had an absolute blast on the 4th of July! The day started early as I joined many of the Knox Democrats for the Farragut 4th of July Parade. = Team Gloria has 42 wonderful new interns statewide, and I got to hang out with some of them in Knox. They are so impressive! 🚫 Fighting for Contraception Access 🚫 = Last month, Senate Republicans, including Marsha Blackburn, blocked a bill granting a federal right to birth control. So, I stood in protest with Senator Charlane Oliver and other colleagues in front of the Tennessee State Capitol — along with a giant 20-foot inflatable IUD. Yes, you read that right — a 20-foot inflatable IUD! = I also joined Joy Reid on MSNBC to talk about how Marsha Blackburn and the GOP are destroying our freedoms. Let’s be honest, Marsha Blackburn was never going to stop with abortion. She and her Republican allies have always had one end goal: complete control over women’s bodies and our reproductive rights. Contraception changed everything for women, and I’ll be damned if we’re forced to go back. We have to kick Marsha and her extremist allies OUT of Washington if we’re going to protect access to birth control and restore abortion rights nationwide. 🎙️ Speaking Out Against Voter Suppression 🎙️ I joined Justin Kanew on the TN Holler podcast to talk about voter suppression and the recent GOP tactics in Tennessee. In case you missed it, election officials sent letters to over 14,000 Tennesseans asking for proof of U.S. citizenship to vote. Let’s be clear: This isn’t about protecting the integrity of our elections. It’s about silencing us. It’s about making it harder for everyday Tennesseans, especially those from marginalized communities, to exercise their fundamental right to vote. 🏢 New Campaign Offices! 🏢 Big news, y'all! Last month we opened brand-new campaign offices in Memphis and Nashville! = Here, we'll map out strategies, connect with volunteers, and push forward our vision for Tennessee. = While Marsha Blackburn is busy clinking glasses with Donald Trump and cozying up to special interests down in Florida, I'm right here, on the ground, meeting with Tennesseans and discussing the real issues that affect our lives. = Thank you to everyone who attended; your support means the world to me. 🔥 Unstoppable Women of Nashville 🔥 I am beyond honored to be featured in “The Unstoppable Women of Nashville” this month in Bitter Southerner’s all-women issue. They highlighted me for standing tall with the Tennessee Three for gun violence survivors and my effort to protect our communities in the state legislature. = As your next senator, I will fight tooth and nail to pass common-sense gun legislation, come hell or high water. 🌈 Celebrating Pride Month 🌈 Last month was Pride Month, and we had an absolute blast at Nashville Pride! = = While we celebrate love in all its colors, let’s remember: this fight isn’t just about parades — it’s about protection. It’s about persistence. It’s about pushing back with everything we’ve got. Republicans like Marsha are trying to strip these freedoms away. I'm determined to pass the Equality Act when I am in the Senate. That’s just a bit of what I’ve been up to, y’all! It’s important to me to keep you up to date on news from the campaign trail and beyond, so you’ll see more news from me in the coming months. If you want the latest news in real-time, be sure to follow me on social media: | All my best, Gloria Johnson = | = Gloria Johnson is running for the U.S. Senate because Tennesseans deserve leaders who care. For too long, elected officials like Marsha Blackburn have done absolutely nothing to make Tennesseans’ lives better. The only interests they’ve cared about are special interests. | | | I endured the gauntlet of West Point Military Academy, then boot camp, then became a Tank Platoon Leader in the final days of the Cold War.

I briefed President Trump on America's most classified matters of national security while Director of CIA.

And I stood eye-to-eye with the most dangerous dictators in the world as Trump's Secretary of State.

**It takes a lot to make me feel on edge. So the fact that I 'm even sending you this email should give you pause. **

Because I'm afraid we have a problem. A big one.

I just got word that Joe Biden and the Democrats are _closer than they 've ever been before_ to destroying our Conservative House Majority once and for all. The latest reports show they've stockpiled over $100,000,000 to defeat us in enough swing states to bring forth a COMPLETE LIBERAL TAKEOVER.

The ONLY THING standing in the way of Joe Biden having full control - and ramming through any radical policy he wants - is just a few competitive House seats. That's it.

I don't tell you this lightly and I know that's not what you want to see happen to our country.

_**[That's why I'm rushing to you, in partnership with Majority Leader Steve Scalise, to raise a game-changing one million dollars in the next 72 hours.](https://click.gopactionalert.com/u/click?_t=093aa899b2bd42648f5b5caa6c6024d8&_m=a339ed66d6594e52bc2552493911f5b7&_e=wjduxou0VbZ-GksJWCNQ5fCiQdTw0sF0AHTU1BIfqMVn0n0znboUQaQAfl_-vRbxrLdbG8AUZmByD2H4_zZLbYMr5G0chfELoc73EWoXyowJnWcInRt4stReutSgHMq1G_BcBelLOs0tDl1wywVK4Fcj78r9tx3gcWpsijpXxMKAeRWZjoMK8poj3qnYp3L0A2Ou2InzmhNeAsZ6ZoA2UO7Qzm3AN9LmddJMCz4tz-HwU7bbj7ysVoEMAUhKxVqIF7ISnLPr70bwz5VMlD1DfaJnWRj4LdicckszfM244oVvvBXT9T215h_4sLjpexSlqC452x23nKIts8dQbiFTXwL6eJPRXordGEewuKgkkbWUmsQ_aNsc6WDTq3u0LczH9loO0VnrUqDhqtx2ovKYuVOzPKNRHWtmMtQmpVSoqzo%3D "That’s why I’m rushing to you, in partnership with Majority Leader Steve Scalise, to raise a game-changing one million dollars in the next 72 hours.")**_ I know what you're thinking... that's not enough runway to raise that much. name: Amanda Chase
subject: Trump Was Shot Today
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Friends of Amanda Chase
body:
We Knew This Would Happen
| | | | PRESIDENT TRUMP WAS SHOT TODAY
---
---
| Friends, You've said it. I've said it. They're going to try to kill President Trump. Today was the day they tried to kill him.
President Trump was shot.
Thankfully, reports say he was only nicked by a bullet and he is going to be okay.
Tragically, one rally attendee was shot and killed. Our heartfelt condolences to the victim's family.
I'm going to call it like I see it. This was an assassination attempt to take out President Trump. It's obvious to everyone but the legacy media.
They've done everything they could do to destroy him politically, financially, and personally, but it didn't work. In fact, these attempts only made him grow in popularity.
They see the polls. They know he's going to win in November. Make no mistake. This was an attempt to take him out, because everything else they tried failed.
In a day and time when it seems courage, bravery and valor are only a glimmer of the past, I loved seeing President Trump rise up even after being shot and defiantly shake his fist telling us to "fight."
This is not a call to fight for the sake of fighting, but a call to save our country from every evil that is trying to kill our country- including political correctness, deviant and evil indoctrination of our children, and the fight against turning America into a socialist country.
His strength is so inspiring. I pray his example spurs us all on to be fearless and courageous against tyrants who want to destroy America.
Aren't you sick and tired of the rhetoric by Democrats saying President Trump is a threat to democracy? He is not. The truth is, he's one of the only elected officials to truly stand up to the oligarchs. That reminds of a quote from Saul Alinsky.
"Accuse your opponent of what you are doing, to create confusion and to inculcate voters against evidence of your own guilt" - Saul Alinsky, Rules for (Reactionaries) Radicals
They labeled those of us who attended the January 6 Trump rally in DC as insurrectionists, when in fact they were the insurrectionists.
We the People are sick and tired of authoritarians hijacking our elections so they can install those who would take away our freedoms. We know President Trump is standing in the gap for us, against them. We believe this nightmare will be over once he returns to the White House. We long for the free America we once knew.
President Trump is a hero to freedom loving Americans who respect his courage and incredible strength and tenacity in the midst of adversity.
We need to follow President Trump's example of courage and strength.
---
|
---
They want you to be afraid. Don't be.
They don't want you to go to a Trump rally as free people should safely be able to do.
They can't stand to see all of the support for President Trump at rallies across America. They didn't just attempt to take out President Trump. They attempted to take out you.
Will you now think twice about going to a Trump rally?
I'm reminded of[ Psalm 91](https://byh4wqwab.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001j0Hfj86-z_DuLa3C1nFQg-qQ0WJgjuMatgUyL0C54BzPi_ycNdIhsWjGErC778fhQNWb1JKoN4EJfegpYC1UwJ1xgq9o8TscIMp0EvSKgncz7c5Lto73nqeBHJssdX72g36O3-B1TEIXGiDfCIy8TTEs0QzAtrcPzcsuyQCPpLWcY-f8gisIncVuVSNuaWOBmN7U8LgLhrOsLSX_b_VGL9nPS9qbLMlU&c=aoY4JX5N2mS0YF51nsVysHL1G8cDYjnpKrwcIdg-pepGtJMly0BvwQ==&ch=DW1kGeoR0nbxh7XtNw8nYXHm-xz0uRwdXvMN7j9XtyGcwi3uS7DotA==)
If you say, "The Lord is my refuge," and you make the Most High your dwelling, no harm will overtake you, no disaster will come near your tent.
For he will command his angels concerning you to guard you in all your ways;
they will lift you up in their hands, so that you will not strike your foot against a stone.
Refuse to be afraid. Don't let them silence you.
Trust God with your life and charge forward. Never retreat.
To "Make America Great Again" we're going to have to show the same tenacity, grit, strength, courage and boldness that President Trump displayed today to defend justice and freedom.

---

#### Are you receiving political ads from a state that you don’t live in? If so, here’s what you should do ...
People are reporting to us that they’re receiving texts and emails from candidates running for offices in states in which they do not live, specifically Arizona and Florida. On a hunch, the individuals used our [Scan. Check. Protect.](https://link.mail.beehiiv.com/ss/c/u001.bYZLwP2tKNW52PF5H5Fs6VDKmqL7dnq-Z_xN8QkhdZKgsxsq4umEAocVLBID6l-zNtT8Cdg3GPakOs5Hew5FuYwKbxgNdhoBvt_chMlwvSKCxEaOX0ckgpTb-r1rCfsZ5eOTo2j02Qxe371bqhzfqM-_vwmWD7oyfGD5mgtvqgxQ4UUEGLEGpJo_sUS4EYa9-Pqs52oFqcKw0A7HrBSrgUFvVjKMUoWtK-dHuEULNbwZjKfbiv3z9Ec4-mcHMsnso43dsyxFLz4MNhpwWUwTdg/480/2hDwx8BhRFu1mM7wq9S9xg/h2/h001.cW3g-dRgf5q19CNjKOMWZ_0XxKAc8BbtfPN4Z2sYu8U)([https://truethevote.org/registration](https://link.mail.beehiiv.com/ss/c/u001.bYZLwP2tKNW52PF5H5Fs6VDKmqL7dnq-Z_xN8QkhdZKgsxsq4umEAocVLBID6l-zNtT8Cdg3GPakOs5Hew5FuYwKbxgNdhoBvt_chMlwvSKCxEaOX0ckgpTb-r1rCfsZ5eOTo2j02Qxe371bqhzfqM-_vwmWD7oyfGD5mgtvqgxQ4UUEGLEGpJo_sUS4EYa9-Pqs52oFqcKw0A7HrBSrgUFvVjKMUoWtK-dHuEULNbwZjKfbiv3z9Ec4-mcHMsnso43dsyxFLz4MNhpwWUwTdg/480/2hDwx8BhRFu1mM7wq9S9xg/h3/h001.X633Q8MidgUL6FUFmAm0AGk3OF6s0-RscHWoKKtli0E)) program to look up their names in the voter rolls of the state in question. They found that their information had been used to register to vote.
How could this happen? Databases containing personal information can be purchased or scraped from the internet. The data can then be used to steal identities for the purpose of voter registration. Email and cell phone information are often included in these datasets. Campaigns then use the same data to solicit votes or donations.
We don’t know how widespread this could be. And maybe there is some plausible explanation that could allay our concerns. But we wanted to bring this to your attention without delay. Better safe than sorry.
If you are receiving political material from a state you don’t live in, your identity could have been used to register to vote. You can use [Scan. Check. Protect](https://link.mail.beehiiv.com/ss/c/u001.bYZLwP2tKNW52PF5H5Fs6VDKmqL7dnq-Z_xN8QkhdZKgsxsq4umEAocVLBID6l-zNtT8Cdg3GPakOs5Hew5FuYwKbxgNdhoBvt_chMlwvSKCxEaOX0ckgpTb-r1rCfsZ5eOTo2j02Qxe371bqhzfqM-_vwmWD7oyfGD5mgtvqgxQ4UUEGLEGpJo_sUS4EYa9-Pqs52oFqcKw0A7HrBSrgUFvVjKMUoWtK-dHuEULNbwZjKfbiv3z9Ec4-mcHMsnso43dsyxFLz4MNhpwWUwTdg/480/2hDwx8BhRFu1mM7wq9S9xg/h4/h001.Wxv23sKxoXu4CW0UQU1SdILRQEpUwmkAPZm0f3P6A94). to look up your information in the state in question.

The above video is of a CNN reporter, who we believe to be CNN Senior Investigative Reporter Kyung Lah, knocking on the door of a volunteer from Texas. After the volunteer rejected CNN’s advances through email and phone, they set up cameras in her yard, started filming, and knocked on the front door with microphones ready for ambush. Things escalated quickly. Wisely, CNN chose to leave.
Volunteers are being tracked by CNN because of their participation in a project we are supporting, called IV3 ([iv3.us](https://link.mail.beehiiv.com/ss/c/u001.sV4MFbzBllccGzy2svLCokN9gYO8jdh-gSJJK-hMZ8MuwQarFK8uveiTwuNNpIl1BO0hLCdJFOwl4U61NkEK7JakHP5I8pOzXqkPA7Qry7X8WF84cheHFIOm9ZJ89vKMEJ6PYirJlecgHzFZYgNlUfne5PsRv55z2zNcKRCH0Zp8Vy1q3KNLUucOPck8SAiPqTeTRqghbdB0BAPj2Y3HZnNdoBAmFIAlnSZZqHyBdjc0MlGVJtu9-Lan08Q8LoOK/480/2hDwx8BhRFu1mM7wq9S9xg/h6/h001.xqKBToJMLh1PstAcawvEhM2OkbkR-PLqfJMIGt8nre8)) . IV3 equips volunteers to review and submit likely ineligible voter registration records to their respective counties. CNN is filing open records requests for all documents received regarding “voter challenges” and the counties are obliged to respond, which gives CNN access to the volunteer’s information, along with any voter records submitted.
We’ve received numerous reports from volunteers across the country, all concerned because CNN is hounding them via phone,text,email, and in person. This is not the only report from Texas volunteers, but it’s the only one with video (so far). Other reports are coming from Arizona and South Carolina.
We are advising volunteers to call the police.
We are also weighing legal options on behalf of TTV volunteers. This is an attempt to harass and intimidate concerned citizens.
**If this is happening to you, please let us know at**[**info@truethevote.org**](mailto:info@truethevote.org)****

Saturday, July 13, 2024 | Peter -- Summer is well and truly underway as this heatwave bakes the country. But our Forward volunteers and committees aren't stopping the ever-important work of building a new home for the politically homeless. Today, we'd like to feature two of our committees help build this party from the ground up, ensuring that all Americans are represented in the party.
### Forward Party Women's Committee
Strength in Numbers. Women have the unique distinction of being the **largest demographic in the United States**. From the founding of our country until now, the legacy parties have _fallen short_ of tapping this vast reserve of strength and wisdom for the good of the country and its citizens. The Forward Party Women’s Committee seeks to remedy this shortfall by **empowering women to serve in politics and society** with equal representation, equal leadership, and equal influence, for enhanced benefit. We need women with _open minds_ , _fresh ideas_ , and _rational voices_ to join the Forward party at all levels of commitment to bring this about. [Engage with us by joining the movement! ](https://home.forwardparty.com/women_committee?e=61868e7acdd36ae0ddf3e39aa8429171&utm_source=forwardparty&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=a_fast_forward_46&n=2)
### Young Forwardists Committee
The Young Forwardists Committee is Forward’s charge to **break the barriers** constraining youth activism. Join our ranks as a member or volunteer to find empowerment, political opportunity, and civil discourse! The Young Forwardists are looking for volunteers to start clubs on high school or college campuses. These clubs will serve as the campus’ home base for doing **real work** in politics through community-building events, safe discussions, and **petitions, which we make real through activism**.
